Title: Data Scientist
Description:
På B3 Indes förvandlar vi data till värdefulla insikter som driver förändring och innovation. Vi skapar lösningar inom AI, Business Intelligence, Data Science och Automation för att maximera värdet av data och stärka företags konkurrenskraft. Vår styrka ligger i att kombinera passion för AI och data med en stark laganda, där vi stöttar varandra och löser utmaningar tillsammans.

Rollen som Data Scientist på B3

Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:


Gräva i data och hitta insikter som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.
Bygga och implementera avancerade lösningar – och faktiskt se dem göra skillnad!


Här handlar det inte bara om teknik – det handlar om att skapa verklig förändring. Vi gillar att tänka stort, experimentera och lösa kluriga problem tillsammans. Och det bästa? Du får ett team av grymma kollegor att bolla idéer med, lära dig av och ha kul ihop med!

Det är din passion för AI och data som gör skillnaden. Utöver det ser vi gärna:


Har du en universitetsutbildning inom matematik eller statistik? Toppen! Har du kanske skaffat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet? Det funkar lika bra!
Minst 4 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – vi letar efter någon som har hunnit samla på sig en del erfarenhet inom området.
Flytande svenska och engelska – eftersom båda språken används dagligen i arbetet.
Tidigare konsultroller är ett plus! Har du jobbat som konsult tidigare? Då är det en extra merit, men inget krav.


Men framför allt...

Har du erfarenhet av Machine Learning och Python? Grymt – det är värdefullt! Men vi lägger också stor vikt vid din förmåga att se helheten, skapa användbara lösningar men framförallt att du är nyfiken. Om du dessutom har koll på A/B-testning, modellering eller visualisering, är det ett plus – men absolut inget krav.

Varför välja B3 Indes?

💡 Utveckling & karriär – Väx i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där din kompetens får ta plats.

🌿 Balans & välmående – Vi värnar om ditt välbefinnande med stöd för wellness och en flexibel vardag.

🚀 Energi & gemenskap – Här präglas kulturen av öppenhet, nyfikenhet och en passion för att skapa något större – tillsammans.

❤️ Vi bryr oss – på riktigt – Vi engagerar oss i samhällsfrågor och samarbetar med initiativ som Suicide Zero, My Dream Now och Pink Programming för att göra skillnad även utanför arbetslivet.

En arbetsplats som gör skillnad:

Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till ett av Sveriges fem främsta karriärföretag 2025 – en utmärkelse som speglar vår energi, nyfikenhet och vårt engagemang för att skapa en inkluderande och inspirerande arbetsplats. Här värdesätts olika perspektiv och idéer, och vi tror att det är just det som gör oss starkare.

Hos oss får du friheten att styra över dina uppdrag, din arbetstid och din utveckling. Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftiga löner, flexibilitet att forma din vardag och en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid. Och vi vet att gemenskap är minst lika viktigt som teknik – därför satsar vi på allt från konferensresor och sommarfester till sköna AW:s där vi kan släppa jobbet för en stund.

Om B3 Consulting Group

B3 Consulting Group är ett expansivt konsultbolag med cirka 1000 medarbetare. Vi brinner för innovation och hjälper Sveriges ledande företag och organisationer att skapa framtidens möjligheter genom digital transformation. B3 finns på tolv orter i Sverige samt i Polen, med huvudkontor i Stockholm. Bolaget grundades 2003, är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm Small Cap och omsatte 1 141 MSEK 2023.

Vi är stolta över vår prisbelönta företagskultur, där olikheter, erfarenheter och gemensam energi värdesätts. Som ett etiskt och transparent bolag strävar vi efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi är även engagerade i Women in Tech och initiativ för att stärka AI-utbildning för kvinnor. 2024 utsågs vi till Årets Employer Branding-företag, och vår HR-chef vann titeln Årets HR-chef.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Nepa is a strategic marketing intelligence and optimization platform with AI built into everything we do — helping iconic global brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt make smarter marketing decisions, faster.

About the Role

As a Data Scientist at Nepa, you'll turn marketing and brand data into decisions our clients act on. You'll work independently on your own workstreams — designing and building the models, pipelines and analyses that power client projects and our AI-driven products — with senior colleagues close by for the hardest calls. This role suits people who'd rather own a problem end to end than wait to be told how to solve it: one week you might be automating a machine learning pipeline, the next presenting your findings straight to a C-level client stakeholder.

Your Responsibilities

As our Data Scientist, your key responsibilities will include:

Designing and building statistical, machine learning and AI models, pipelines and analyses for client projects and our products.
Translating client business questions into sharp, testable analytical problems.
Using AI to work smarter — automating recurring delivery steps like data preparation, quality checks and reporting, and building faster with AI assistants.
Helping embed AI and machine learning into our products — from a smarter model component in our Continuous MMM to a new signal in Creative AI, our tool for analyzing what makes ad creative perform.
Owning your workstreams end to end, from quality to timelines.
Presenting your findings clearly to your team and, increasingly, directly to clients.

Your Profile

To excel in this role, you should have:

A degree in a quantitative engineering or mathematics field.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Around 1–3 years of hands-on data science and/or data engineering experience.
Strong statistics and applied machine learning, solid Python, and good engineering habits.
A builder's instinct — you spot where a method or process can be improved, and you make it happen.
Comfort with ambiguity: you can choose a sound approach when there's no textbook answer.
Clear communication — you can explain complex analysis to technical and non-technical people alike.
You must have the legal right to work in Sweden. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role.
Nice to have: hands-on experience using AI tools or assistants to speed up your own delivery.

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd still love to hear from you.

A Few More Details

You believe in the power of data and AI to drive smarter decisions and lasting growth.
You share our values: curiosity that sees what others don't, passion that shows, clarity over complexity, and the drive to care and act.
You want the freedom to grow in your own way, backed by the guidance and support of a close-knit team.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

At Xylem, we're tackling some of the world's biggest water challenges through innovation, technology, and data. We're looking for a Data Scientist who is curious, collaborative, and excited about turning complex data into meaningful solutions that help our customers operate more efficiently and sustainably.

In this role, you'll work with operational and sensor data to develop machine learning models, advanced analytics, and AI-powered solutions that generate real-world impact. You'll collaborate with product managers, engineers, domain experts, and customers to uncover opportunities, solve complex problems, and create products that deliver measurable value.

Success in this role comes from combining strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in understanding the systems, processes, and operational environments behind the data.

Responsibilities


Analyze complex operational and sensor data to uncover patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
Design, develop, validate, and deploy machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
Build algorithms for forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive decision support.
Transform business and customer challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions.
Develop a deep understanding of the systems, processes, and operational context behind the data to create impactful analytical solutions.
Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, domain experts, and customers to define and deliver new capabilities.
Leverage modern AI tools and technologies to support data exploration, experimentation, model development, and solution delivery.
Monitor and continuously improve the performance of analytics solutions and machine learning models.
Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies, AI advancements, and analytical methods that can drive innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

We're interested in people with different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about the opportunity and believe you can contribute, we'd love to hear from you.


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience developing machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
Strong Python skills and experience working with large or complex datasets.
Good understanding of statistics, data analysis, and predictive modeling techniques.
Ability to translate business and operational challenges into practical data-driven solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills and a curiosity for discovering meaningful insights from data.
Interest in understanding the systems and processes behind the data and applying that knowledge to analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across teams and disciplines.


Nice to Have

Experience with time-series data, anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive analytics, industrial systems, IoT, or sensor data would be valuable. Familiarity with cloud-based analytics and machine learning platforms, AI-assisted development tools, or cross-functional product development environments is also a plus. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, enjoys collaborating with others, and is motivated by creating meaningful impact through data.

Why Join Xylem?

At Xylem, you'll be part of a global team dedicated to solving critical water and infrastructure challenges. We offer a collaborative and international environment where you'll have opportunities to grow your skills, develop your career, and contribute to innovative solutions that make a difference around the world.

You'll also have the opportunity to engage with Xylem Watermark, our corporate citizenship program focused on education, community involvement, and water stewardship. Learn more at www.xylemwatermark.com.

Belonging at Xylem

At Xylem, we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds strengthen our teams and drive innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed, respected, and empowered to do their best work.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if their experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed. Your unique skills, experiences, and potential may make you the ideal fit for this role.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application in English.

Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Leila.sayyad@xylem.com

Please submit your application through our careers site. We do not accept applications via email.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!

Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:


We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities


We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.

The role:

As a Data Scientist, you will lead high-impact initiatives at the intersection of data science, product, and engineering. The role combines machine learning, statistics, and data engineering to solve meaningful, real-world problems, with strong collaboration at its core, working closely with stakeholders across the organization and within the team to deliver results that no single person could achieve alone.

What You Will Do


Exploring the problem space and finding data science solutions that provide step increases in customer experience
Planning data science work for the team, with an emphasis on collaboration to achieve common goals
Gathering, collating, and understanding the data necessary to create data science products that delight the customers
Collaborating with stakeholders throughout Truecaller to find and build data science products that solve business and customer problems at scale.
Coaching and mentoring junior to senior data scientists to improve their technical skills and productivity


What You Bring In


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience in using data science and machine learning to solve real-world problems
Excellent programming skills in Python and SQL
Solid understanding and experience with the tooling for Python - IDEs, unit testing frameworks, and static code checks
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex data and insights to non-technical stakeholders
Strong problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset
Customer obsession
Able to own and drive projects and products to production and iteratively improve them over time


It would be great if you also have


Understanding how to query very large data efficiently (we use BigQuery)
Experience collaborating with C-suite executives
Experience with data from mobile applications
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools, such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI (we use Looker)
A solid understanding of the engineering requirements necessary to put machine learning solutions into production and scale them to hundreds of millions of customers


What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:


A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.


Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/

Sounds like a great opportunity?

The role combines machine learning, statistics, and data engineering to solve meaningful, real-world problems, with strong collaboration at its core, working closely with stakeholders across the organization and within the team to deliver results that no single person could achieve alone.

What You Will Do

  • Exploring the problem space and finding data science solutions that provide step increases in customer experience
  • Planning data science work for the team, with an emphasis on collaboration to achieve common goals
  • Gathering, collating, and understanding the data necessary to create data science products that delight the customers
  • Collaborating with stakeholders throughout Truecaller to find and build data science products that solve business and customer problems at scale.
  • Coaching and mentoring junior to senior data scientists to improve their technical skills and productivity

What You Bring In

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in using data science and machine learning to solve real-world problems
  • Excellent programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Solid understanding and experience with the tooling for Python - IDEs, unit testing frameworks, and static code checks
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex data and insights to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset
  • Customer obsession
  • Able to own and drive projects and products to production and iteratively improve them over time

It would be great if you also have

  • Understanding how to query very large data efficiently (we use BigQuery)
  • Experience collaborating with C-suite executives
  • Experience with data from mobile applications
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools, such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI (we use Looker)
  • A solid understanding of the engineering requirements necessary to put machine learning solutions into production and scale them to hundreds of millions of customers

What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

  • A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
  • Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
  • A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
  • Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
⚡️ What We Do

Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing.

Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.

🌟Who We Are

Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.

At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.

To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join us!

👩‍💻 About The Role

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will shape the foundation of Flower’s short-term forecasting capabilities - powering the models that directly drive our daily trading decisions. You will be part of a small, highly skilled team operating at the intersection of data science, energy systems, and close-to-real-time market dynamics.

You will own the full lifecycle of your models - from idea to production - working closely with Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and Energy Market Experts to ensure our forecasting stack runs smoothly and is continuously improving. This is a hands-on role focussed on time-series modelling, rapid experimentation, and the ability to translate data into high-impact operational decisions.

What You’ll Do


Build & maintain short term operational forecasting models for energy volumes & prices that drive our trading decisions on a day-to-day basis
Build time series models to understand and explain recurring patterns across different measurements, products and regions to distill signals as features for your next model
Prototype quickly: iterate on simple models, validate rigorously, and scale what works in a dynamic market environment
Own the full model lifecycle: EDA, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment and continuous evaluation, supported by our team of DEs, MLEs & Energy Market Experts
Write your models in Python, version your code in Git, use CI/CD to ensure full reproducibility
Partner with DEs to evaluate and integrate new data sources (weather, grid conditions, market signals)
Collaborate & mentor across other data scientists, quants and engineers


Who You Are


Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Engineering Physics, or a related quantitative field
5+ years building and deploying time-series prediction models in production using machine learning or classical methods
Strong command of Python and no stranger to the command line; comfortable writing clean, maintainable, production-ready code
Deep understanding of time-series forecasting and real-world modeling challenges
Prior experience in energy markets or power systems
Strong mentorship and coaching skills
Highly driven by our mission and your impact, yet humble enough to know we are all always learning
Eagerness to apply yourself in a mostly automated trading floor environment
Thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt models as markets evolve


📍 Location

Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.

✉️ Apply

Our corporate language is English, as we have over 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.

Throughout the recruitment process you will meet with the Talent Partner, Head of Predictions and Optimization, the Team, VP of Engineering and VP of Product.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Would you like to use modern technology and advanced modelling to deliver market-leading pricing? Join us as our new Data Scientist!

At If, our ability to understand risk and customer behavior through data, analytics, and modelling is at the core of our business and competitive advantage. By developing the most accurate models, we can offer the best pricing and product solutions to our customers. We are currently accelerating our efforts to become the leading organization in data, analytics, and pricing across the Nordic insurance market. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in that journey!

About The Role

As a Data Scientist, your primary responsibility will be to take a leading role in enhancing our risk and pricing models and production processes, directly impacting both our customers and our business. In this role, you will have the opportunity to:


Work with innovative methods in statistical modelling and machine learning.
Analyze large volumes of data and explore new data sources.
Work in our modern analytics platform with end-to-end ownership of the data science process.
Develop, implement, and monitor improvements in an efficient and iterative manner.
Strengthen Nordic collaboration within If’s Nordic analytics community and our sister company Hastings in the UK.


We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:


An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Lunch benefit
High pension savings


About The Team

Our team is responsible for improving pricing for our Swedish personal lines portfolio, covering approximately 1.8 million customers. You will be part of a caring, creative, and high-performing team with a strong passion for data, analytics, and modelling. The team is part of an experienced and growing Nordic pricing & analytics organization.

Who are you?

You have a strong interest in technology, analytics, and data, and can communicate complex insights in a way that resonates with a broad audience. You bring curiosity, creativity, and initiative to your work, and thrive on tackling challenging problems. With a structured and dependable approach, you take ownership of your work and continually seek opportunities to learn and improve.

To Succeed In This Role, We Believe You


Hold a Master's degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
Have work experience from data science, machine learning engineering, or actuarial science
Have programming experience in SQL and Python
Are fluent in both Swedish and English
Have professional proficiency in both English and Swedish


Additional facts and the recruitment process

Application deadline: Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is September 30th.

To apply for the position: Please attach your CV

Work location: Stockholm, Bergshamra

Start: As soon as possible or by agreement

For more information, please contact Laura Ni, *Pricing Data Scientist, laura.ni@if.se .

It is a requirement for the position that If’s extended fit & proper requirements, including background checks, can be met.

We look forward to your application!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique energy trading portfolios on the market.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?

Job Mission 🚀

As a Data Scientist, you'll play a key role in keeping Tibber's energy trading function one step ahead. You'll build and continuously improve a whole portfolio of models: the forecasts our traders lean on when they buy power, and the models that decide how our virtual power plant puts thousands of home batteries and electric cars to work. You will have a direct, measurable impact on our trading outcomes.

What You'll Do ✅

Build and improve day-ahead energy consumption forecasting models that the trading team uses to make power purchase decisions.


Own the full model lifecycle - problem framing, data sourcing, model development, production deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring.
Take models from exploratory notebooks to reliable, production-ready Python systems built for live trading conditions.
Collaborate with backend engineers to bridge model outputs into production infrastructure.
Diagnose and respond to operational issues - missing data inputs, model drift, or unexpected forecast failures, without waiting to be asked.
Continuously raise the accuracy and reliability of our established forecasting systems with direct impact on trading outcomes.


What we're looking for⚡

You Are Driven By Impact And Know How To Turn Strategy Into Execution. You're Used To Fast-paced Environments And Thrive When Given Clear Goals And High Accountability. We Believe You'll Thrive Here If You


Have built and deployed forecasting or time-series models in production - not just in notebooks, and can speak to how those models held up in practice
Write clean, maintainable Python - this is your primary language and you use it comfortably across the full stack from data wrangling to production code
Enjoys owning a project end-to-end - from scoping and data sourcing to a measured outcome
Are curious about the energy trading domain - and motivated to understand the market mechanics behind the models, not just the math
Are a team player - you learn from those around you and share what you know freely
Are excited by AI tools - and how they are changing the way data scientists work and actively look for ways to build smarter, faster workflows with them.


We see it as a plus bust not a must if you also bring: experience in energy, power markets, or demand forecasting in regulated markets.

💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️The Tibber Mindset

Tibber is not your typical energy supplier. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households lower and shift their energy consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours. We’re here to accelerate the energy transition – not in theory, but in everyday life.

Being on a mission to change an industry, fundamentally also means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can’t be done, try and fail together but never lose sight of our users. We work passionately with sustainability and a circular approach, both with our own products and in the entire ecosystem that is affected by everything we do.

Starting out with two passionate founders in 2016, we're now 300+ people working for Tibber in our offices in Stockholm, Førde, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Oslo. We will continue to grow within our markets, and we are thrilled to be backed by investors like Balderton Capital, Eight Roads Ventures, Founders Fund, Summa, and Schibsted.

Diversity of thought fuels better products, so we welcome applicants of every background, identity and lived experience. Ready to be part of powering the energy transition? Apply below!

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Nepa is a strategic marketing intelligence and optimization platform with AI built into everything we do — helping iconic global brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt make smarter marketing decisions, faster.




About the Role

As our Senior Data Scientist, you'll lead the analytical design of our most demanding work and act as the main technical point of contact with our clients. You'll set the technical standard, solve the hardest problems, and be the advisor clients trust when the stakes are high. This role suits people who want to set the approach themselves rather than follow someone else's: one engagement might have you designing a bespoke model from scratch, the next advising a client's senior leadership team on what the numbers really mean.

Your Responsibilities

As our Senior Data Scientist, your key responsibilities will include:

Leading the design and delivery of advanced analytical work — Bayesian and econometric models, larger machine learning pipelines, the problems without a standard playbook.
Leading AI-driven product work, including automated marketing mix modelling, our Trinity AI, and Creative AI — our tool for analyzing which creative elements actually drive ad performance.
Driving AI and automation across the team's delivery — and knowing where it genuinely helps and where it doesn't.
Acting as the main technical point of contact for clients, advising them on where AI and analytics create real value.
Supporting scoping and sales conversations, and spotting where the analytical agenda with a client can go deeper.
Setting methodology, tooling and automation standards, and mentoring colleagues coming up behind you.




Your Profile

To excel in this role, you should have:

A degree in a quantitative mathematics or engineering field (an advanced degree is a plus).
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Around 3–6 years of applied experience in the data science and/or engineering space.
Deep knowledge of statistics and machine learning, with the judgement to choose the right method — and know when AI isn't the right tool.
Genuine specialist depth in your area, with the independence to define an approach when there's no template to follow.
Client-facing confidence — you can explain complex methodology clearly and act as a trusted advisor.
A track record of raising the bar for the people and processes around you.
You must have the legal right to work in Sweden. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role.
Nice to have: experience shaping or scaling an AI-driven product feature

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd still love to hear from you.




A Few More Details

You believe in the power of data and AI to drive smarter decisions and lasting growth.
You share our values: curiosity that sees what others don't, passion that shows, clarity over complexity, and the drive to care and act.
You want the freedom to grow in your own way, backed by the guidance and support of a close-knit team.
You take pride in delivering the clarity, speed, and impact our clients rely on.




Who We Are

At Nepa, we help great brands grow by turning insight into action. We're building a strategic marketing intelligence and optimisation platform for the AI era — connecting continuous data with sharp analytics, machine learning and deep marketing expertise, so businesses can act faster, spend smarter, and focus on what really drives results.




Our platform brings together Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling and Campaign Evaluation into one clear, AI-powered view for marketers and the C-suite alike. It's a transformation with real momentum: we're profitable, our subscription business is accelerating, and our AI-driven products are already proving out in the market. Our Continuous MMM tracks what's driving performance on an ongoing basis rather than waiting for a quarterly report, and our new Creative AI has already helped a client uncover a 40%+ potential reduction in cost-per-acquisition by identifying which creative elements in their ads actually move the needle. We're just getting started — for the right person, that's a real opportunity to help shape what comes next.




We're trusted by more than 300 blue-chip clients across 50+ markets — including brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt — and we track over 7,500 brands and campaigns every day. Founded in Stockholm in 2006 and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Nepa has grown into a team of around 220 people across 10 offices on six continents. We're proud to bring clarity to complexity, and to make insight an engine for growth.




Next Steps

We review applications on a rolling basis, so don't delay — submit your application today to be considered for this exciting opportunity to join our team as a Senior Data Scientist.

We're trusted by more than 300 blue-chip clients across 50+ markets — including brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt — and we track over 7,500 brands and campaigns every day. Founded in Stockholm in 2006 and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Nepa has grown into a team of around 220 people across 10 offices on six continents. We're proud to bring clarity to complexity, and to make insight an engine for growth.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Department of AI
Description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? A hands-on, product-minded Data Scientist who turns rich datasets into intelligent, innovative AI systems that directly shape user experiences and business models. You’re motivated, eager and equipped to make us smarter by using data to innovate in our product offering.

Role? Experienced Data Scientist joining our Department of AI to develop, experiment with, and build machine learning and AI systems that provide new user experiences and business model innovation, in collaboration with our vertical teams.

Company? Vend, parent company of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA, Bilbasen, as well as other top brands, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.

Location? Join us in our central and modern Oslo or Stockholm office with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely!

Why us? The Department of AI is Vend’s biggest AI investment, a central team of 35 experts working to transform Vend’s products, way of working, and strategy using AI. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact through the company’s main AI bets, using data science to make new categories of products possible.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?


You are experienced in Data Science & Machine Learning: You have strong fundamental knowledge of machine learning algorithms and AI, with practical experience in building models and creating scalable solutions.
You are as up to date with modern AI tools and are familiar in using LLMs in your Data Science Practice
You are innovative, collaborative and can apply Data Science principles and techniques to create novel products and business models within cross-functional teams.
You are business oriented, able to see opportunities where AI can improve our products and services.
You are flexible and comfortable with change.


WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?

Day-to-day work & projects cooking


The Data Scientists in our Department of AI (dAI) collaborate in cross-functional, temporary teams with AI, design, product, engineering, and business experts to create agentic and AI-native products for our marketplaces.
Data Science is an integral and essential part of our AI-native product development
Our current projects include Finn Søkelys - an AI-based job matching system that removes the job listing and application from the process; a chat-based discovery experience for people looking for new places to live; and actionable recommendations for car dealers.
We also offer some courses and workshops on Data Science for other employees, mainly engineers, in Vend. In our last courses, we developed our own materials from scratch on NLP, Deep Learning, LLMs behind the scenes, Computer Vision, and more.


The challenge you can turn into an opportunity!

How do we make agentic products work well for users and customers? Which surfaces and problems are AI systems best equipped to solve? What new business opportunities have we neglected, because they were not technologically possible before?

The work we do here is far from trivial, which means that you have an opportunity to do your best work and create something new and amazing.

A few words from the hiring manager

Hi, I’m Vilde, and I manage the Data Science team in dAI. The team consists of 5 Data Scientists, including you, who work alone or in pairs in projects to develop AI-native products for our marketplaces. We come together to discuss approaches and applications, and we develop Data Science courses and workshops for other people in the company. We are looked up to as experts, and expected to stay on top of AI developments and how to apply them effectively. Something exciting about us is that we love change, and we follow the biggest opportunities - the department itself will wind down at the end of 2027, and we strongly expect to find new homes for the roles in the business units. Data Science is an important and strategic capability for Vend.

Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

Make sure to apply by the 27th of September. We will review applications on a rolling basis, appreciate and encourage earlier applications.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Since you’ve landed on this page, you already know Hedvig is a mover and shaker in insurtech, and think you might have what it takes to join us. We’ve been working hard since the very beginning to change an industry that is hard to love – to something at least likable. At Hedvig, we believe the only way to do so is to work with great people.




What about the role?

We are now looking for a Data Scientist to join our ambitious team at Hedvig, to solve complex business problems across the Hedvig using the latest advancements in AI and Machine Learning. The role involves high-impact work designing and developing ML models and agentic AI solutions for fair pricing, reserving, and lifetime value and more.




We believe, and know from experience, that we can accelerate faster by owning the entire pipeline from raw data to deployed model, reaping the benefits from developing with AI. Working closely with experienced backend developers, ML engineers, data analysts, and various business teams, you will have the opportunity to shape the data, tools, and innovative solutions that fuel our growth. This offers an inspiring freedom in what you will be able to create.




In the role you will:




Be a driving force in the development of our proprietary, next generation pricing platform powered by agentic AI development
Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and agentic AI systems to solve challenges across the business, including:
Engineering dynamic risk models to deliver highly personalized and competitive premium structures that balance fairness with sustainable profitability
Performing and developing the end-to-end reserving process, blending actuarial analysis with the continuous automation of our workflows
Driving sales growth by developing and deploying Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models to optimize our marketing strategies
Drive machine learning and AI projects from project definition and raw data to deployed model and tracking of performance, with full end-to-end ownership
Evangelize the power of data and AI by promoting your work to the team, stakeholders and Hedvig as a whole
Be a driving force by always being on the lookout for new trends within AI, and Insurtech




What about you?

The Foundation: You hold a Master’s. in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
Proven Impact: Relevant professional experience delivering ML models end-to-end in production, preferably in Fintech or Insurtech. Direct exposure to insurance pricing, actuarial frameworks, or credit risk modeling is a significant advantage that will distinguish your profile.
The Generative Frontier: You are hands-on or experimenting with the modern AI stack, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, and fine-tuning
Agentic Thinking: You have a thirst for building and deploying agentic AI systems capable of complex, multi-step decision-making and tool-use within a business context
From Foundations to Frontiers: You possess a deep algorithmic understanding of machine learning models - from classical GLMs and GBMs to Transformers. You use this knowledge to independently select, develop, interpret, and evaluate the most appropriate solutions for complex problems.
Full-Stack Mindset: You are highly proficient in Python and standard DS libraries, with strong working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing, transforming and working with large datasets for ML.
Production-Ready: Experience deploying and operating ML solutions in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD and best MLOps practices.
The AI Advocate: You thrive in collaborations, translating problems into rigorous quantifiable solutions, and love evangelizing ML models and agentic AI
Business impact: You independently validate models and interpret their performance to make decisions maximising the business impact of them.




Those are not hard requirements! If you have a different profile but you see that you have relevant skills and you think you can do a remarkable job, apply and share with us your motivation on why we should meet you.




What about us?

As part of the Hedvig team, you quickly notice that "general truths" are not accepted without being questioned. We're an enthusiastic group of people who love to challenge each other to find the best way forward. We don't care who says something; we care about what's being said. We put a lot of effort into building a trusting culture where freedom, collective thinking, and individual ownership have center stage. We're not perfect – far from it – but we talk about and learn from our mistakes and imperfections to improve continuously. And we have a lot of fun along the way! As individuals, as a team, and as a company.




Come join the Hedvig team, including all of our very loved office pups, in newly renovated offices in central Stockholm.

Samarbeta med andra specialistteam för att utveckla datadrivna arbetssätt och initiativ.
Proaktivt identifiera affärsmöjligheter och förbättringsområden genom avancerad dataanalys.
Ta fram beslutsunderlag och presentera insikter till management och andra beslutsfattare.

Grundläggande krav:


Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet av att arbeta som Data Scientist eller Data Analyst.
Du är bekväm med att använda Python och SQL.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med visualiseringsverktyg som PowerBI och Qlik Sense.
Förmåga att driva uppgifter självständigt.
Relevant akademisk utbildning inom statistik, ekonomi, datavetenskap, matematik eller motsvarande.
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
Bosatt i Sverige, med placering i Stockholm med omnejd.



Meriterande kvalifikationer:


Erfarenhet från arbete inom bank eller andra finansiella tjänster.
Kunskap om bolånemarknaden och fastighetsmarknaden.
Erfarenhet från verktyg som Snowflake och Databricks.
Erfarenhet av språkmodeller.



Hos oss kan du uppleva:


Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.
Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.
En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.
En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.
Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.

Title: Data Scientist, Company Planning & Execution
Description:
How does a company with thousands of people building hundreds of products stay focused on what matters most? That's the question the Company Planning and Execution (CPE) team works on every day. We design the systems, processes, and insights that help Spotify plan, prioritise, and deliver at scale.

As a Data Scientist on CPE, you'll sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and operations. You'll bring clarity to complex questions by turning operational and strategic information into clear stories, recommendations, and decision frameworks that help leaders and teams act faster and smarter. You'll also explore how AI and automation can change the way people access insights and make decisions.

You'll work closely with data scientists, engineers, PMs, and business partners across the company to help refine how Spotify executes at scale. If you like making sense of ambiguity, care about how organisations work, and want your analysis to shape real decisions, this is the role.

What You'll Do


Formulate hypotheses related to how Spotify plans and delivers, and communicate insights effectively to a range of audiences.
Apply analytical techniques — including statistical models and machine learning — to identify trends and generate insights that improve how we work.
Build and maintain the data models, pipelines, and dashboards that provide visibility into how Spotify plans and executes.
Develop structured narratives and recommendations — not just charts, but the "why" and "so what" — in our semi-annual Planning and Execution Insight reports and recurring briefings.
Explore how AI and automation can make insights faster to produce and easier to access across the company.


Who You Are


Curious about how organisations work — not just the data, but the decisions and systems behind it.
5+ years of experience with a quantitative background in science, economics, engineering, or a related field.
Strong interpersonal skills and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across levels and functions.
Able to take messy, complex datasets and turn them into clear recommendations and stories that land with non-technical audiences.
Proficient in SQL and Python, comfortable in BigQuery, and experienced with tools like dbt, Tableau, or Looker.
Experience with operational or work management data is a plus.


Where You'll Be


This role is based in London or Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best, with 2–3 days per week in the office.


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We're Looking For


Commercially-minded owner: A data scientist who owns pricing and packaging outcomes. You find the opportunity, model it, test it, and drive the change.
Economics fluency: Deep understanding of unit economics including LTV, margin, token and infrastructure cost, willingness to pay, discounting, and subscription or credit models.
Technical rigor: Strong SQL, Python, applied statistics, and experimentation skills. You are comfortable with causal questions where a clean A/B test is not always possible.
Systems builder: You build the systems that price and package, such as discounting or packaging models that run on user records, rather than just delivering one-off analyses.
Strategic judgment: An instinct for the tradeoff between growth and monetization, and the judgment to know when to prioritize each.
Entrepreneurial spirit: You thrive with autonomy and enjoy working closely with finance, product, and growth teams.


What You'll Do


Own the analytics behind pricing and packaging: what we charge, how we package it, and the impact of changes on revenue, conversion, and retention.
Build models for unit economics, willingness to pay, and price sensitivity, translating them into concrete pricing bets.
Design and execute pricing and packaging experiments, and act decisively on the results.
Build the systems that operationalize pricing decisions, such as personalized discounting based on user records.
Collaborate with finance, product, and growth to sequence and ship pricing changes effectively.


Our tech stack

Title: Staff Data Scientist - Experience
Description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Content Platform is responsible for the full content lifecycle at Spotify — from ingestion through to delivery — across music, podcasts, and audiobooks. We ensure content is structured, evaluated, and delivered reliably at global scale, powered by deep content understanding. We bring valuable content to users while ensuring it remains trusted and high-quality over time. The Product Insights team works across the full content lifecycle to improve decision-making, improve our catalog understanding and ensure one of the world’s largest content catalogs is safe and engaging.

We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist to join the team and tackle complex, high-impact problems by combining strategic thinking with hands-on, tactical execution.

What You'll Do


Lead analyses across user behavior and content data to shape product and strategy decisions.
Shape how we evaluate and improve content classification and taxonomy, with a particular focus on safety, combining analytical depth with a broader view of product and business needs.
Design evaluation frameworks, including sampling strategies, setting baselines, metrics, and annotation-based approaches, and guide how these methods are applied across the team.
Build scalable analytical foundations, including metrics, dashboards, and the data and context needed to enable effective self-serve analysis and agents.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership to shape priorities and how data informs product strategy.
Raise the analytical bar across Product Insights through methodological leadership, mentorship, and by identifying opportunities to improve how we work with data across domains.


Who You Are


You have deep experience as a product data scientist and have operated at Staff level or equivalent.
You have a strong foundation in statistics and experience designing evaluation and measurement approaches, including annotation-based methods and settings where controlled experiments are not feasible.
You have experience in building metrics and reporting systems that support product or policy decision-making.
You have built self-serve analytical tools or data agents that enable others to answer questions effectively.
You are proficient in SQL and experienced with Python, DBT, or similar tools for building and maintaining reliable analytical datasets
You leverage state of the art LLM models to do your analysis while ensuring quality and accuracy in the output
You communicate clearly across functions, influence decisions with senior stakeholders, and help raise analytical standards through mentorship and methodological leadership.
You have experience working on content classification, taxonomy, safety, policy, or adjacent domains where data quality and judgment are important to product decisions.


Where You'll Be


This role is based in Stockholm or London.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Title: Data Scientist - Anti-cheat
Description:
The Anti-cheat team at Embark is responsible for upholding the integrity of our games, identifying instances of unfair play, and protecting the experience of our players. We have a versatile toolbox at our disposal, which we continuously evolve and refine, including client-side protections, third-party systems, machine-learning models. Being a core function supporting all of Embark games, we collaborate with many different stakeholders throughout the organisation, such as game teams, legal and community management.

We are now looking for a well rounded Data scientist to strengthen our operational capacity. As a member of our Anti-cheat team you will, among other things, be responsible for supporting our game teams with investigations into suspicious activities, performance analyses of detection rules, exploration of data and player behavior to design new rules. Your statistical background helps you identify significant patterns, and separate signals from noise. We operate in a complex environment where billions of telemetry events and other data are collected each day from all our games.

You are likely curious to continuously learn new skills. You enjoy working autonomously and taking initiatives, while also collaborating within and across teams. You have a passion for data and technology, and feel excited to use your skills to help protect our players from unfair play and malicious actors. By being creative and experimental you aim to solve problems in a game-changing way.

Example Of Responsibilities


Perform ad-hoc investigations into suspicious patterns and gameplay behavior
Work with game teams and customer support to verify and explain rule detections
Support our Esport event teams with vetting of contestants
Provide reports and performance analyses of our anti-cheat operation



We would love if you have


A creative and curious mind.
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with database querying, preferably using tools such as BigQuery
Proficiency in Python.
Experience working with Google Cloud Platform.
Experience working with ETLs and data pipelines.
Experience in predictive modeling and analysis over large datasets
Professional English communication skills.
Experience and/or interest in games and anti-cheat will be considered a bonus!



At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

We welcome game makers of all sex, class, colour, age, gender identity, education, religion, opinion, culture, nation of origin, language, sexual orientation, shape, size, and ability.

Did we leave anyone out? Well, we welcome you, too! We think that the gaming industry is made better when everyone has a seat at the table.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

Title: DYNAMIC PRICING SCIENTIST
Description:
About the role and the challenges you will work on:

Build the Algorithms Behind the Future of Airline Pricing

At SAS, we are building next-generation Dynamic Pricing capabilities that will transform how airline offers are priced, customized, and optimized.

As a Dynamic Pricing Scientist, you will apply Operations Research, Statistics, Machine Learning, and Economic thinking to solve some of the most challenging commercial optimization problems in aviation.

You will work in a highly skilled team of scientists and product managers where your models will directly influence pricing decisions at scale, working at the intersection of mathematics, economics, customer behavior, and technology.

You will also own the science behind our Dynamic Pricing algorithms.


Develop, improve, and deploy Dynamic Pricing models.
Design optimization approaches that maximize revenue while delivering customer value.
Analyze customer behavior, booking patterns, competitive dynamics, and market conditions.
Collaborate with Product Managers to translate business opportunities into analytical solutions.
Work closely with engineers to operationalize models in production environments.
Design experiments and evaluate business impact.
Contribute to the broader evolution of Revenue Management, pricing, forecasting, and optimization capabilities at SAS.
Help define the future analytical agenda of Revenue Management and Network Optimization Science.


The Team

You’ll join a high-performing and diverse team of talented professionals with a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. As our Dynamic Pricing team continues to grow, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to its development and help shape the way we work. We value collaboration, curiosity and innovation, and foster an inclusive environment where people support one another, share ideas and succeed together.

To be successful we believe you have

You enjoy solving complex business problems using quantitative methods and have a strong desire to create measurable business impact.

We Believe You Have


MSc or PhD in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience applying analytical methods to real-world business problems.
Strong programming skills in Python, R, SQL, or equivalent.
Ability to structure ambiguity and translate business questions into analytical approaches.
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.


Nice To Have


Experience with Pricing, Revenue Management, Forecasting, Optimization, or Decision Science.
Experience developing Machine Learning models in production environments.
Familiarity with airline, travel, retail, e-commerce, mobility, or marketplace industries.
Experience with experimentation and causal inference.
Knowledge of Operations Research techniques including optimization, simulation, or forecasting.


Why SAS?

Benefits

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:


Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

We welcome diverse perspectives and particularly encourage applications from women.

Additional Information


Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
Desired start date: As soon as possible.
Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period.
This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite. Remote work and employment in Copenhagen may also be options, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
To be eligible for this position you need an EU-work permit. Please note that we ask you to inform us if you currently have a valid EU-work permit.

  • Experience applying analytical methods to real-world business problems.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, R, SQL, or equivalent.
  • Ability to structure ambiguity and translate business questions into analytical approaches.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Pricing, Revenue Management, Forecasting, Optimization, or Decision Science.

  • Familiarity with airline, travel, retail, e-commerce, mobility, or marketplace industries.
  • Experience with experimentation and causal inference.

Why SAS?

Benefits

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:

  • Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

We welcome diverse perspectives and particularly encourage applications from women.

Additional Information

  • Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
  • Desired start date: As soon as possible.
  • Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period.
  • This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite. Remote work and employment in Copenhagen may also be options, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
  • To be eligible for this position you need an EU-work permit. Please note that we ask you to inform us if you currently have a valid EU-work permit.

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. Significant experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills

Title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist (French speaking)
Description:
About the role




This week CNN and Reuters reported on our work in DRC together with Vodacom, WHO, Congo government, African CDC and other where we are using mobile-phone data to understand population movements and get ahead of the Ebola outbreak. This is part of Flowminder's work, and we need one more person on the team doing it.




You'll turn mobile operator, survey and spatial data into population and mobility statistics that ministries of health, national statistics offices and UN agencies rely on for outbreak response, humanitarian planning and development decision-making in DRC and beyond. About a third of the role is training and building capacity with our partner institutions, in French and English, including travel to the countries we work in. It's a job where what you produce on a Tuesday can shape decisions on the ground by Friday.




We're looking for someone with a strong quantitative background, solid Python and time-series skills, spatial data experience, and professional working French.

Permanent, full-time, based in Stockholm or Southampton (hybrid).

Deadline: 30 September 2026. We review on a rolling basis.




Full details and how to apply: https://lnkd.in/d2eff96M




About Flowminder

Flowminder is a non-profit foundation. We enable decision makers to access the data they need to transform the lives of vulnerable people, at scale.

We analyse pseudonymised mobile operator data, satellite imagery and household survey data to measure where people are and how they move. Flowminder researchers were the first to use mobile operator data to track population movements after a large-scale disaster and during a major infectious disease outbreak, following the 2010 Haiti earthquake and cholera outbreak. We work with national statistics offices, health ministries and disaster management agencies in low- and middle-income countries, alongside UN agencies, the World Bank and development banks.

We are a small team, based mainly in Southampton and Stockholm, working in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Haiti, Ghana and Pakistan. Our working language is English, but much of our work with partners is in French.
