Title: DYNAMIC PRICING SCIENTIST
Description:
About the role and the challenges you will work on:

Build the Algorithms Behind the Future of Airline Pricing

At SAS, we are building next-generation Dynamic Pricing capabilities that will transform how airline offers are priced, customized, and optimized.

As a Dynamic Pricing Scientist, you will apply Operations Research, Statistics, Machine Learning, and Economic thinking to solve some of the most challenging commercial optimization problems in aviation.

You will work in a highly skilled team of scientists and product managers where your models will directly influence pricing decisions at scale, working at the intersection of mathematics, economics, customer behavior, and technology.

You will also own the science behind our Dynamic Pricing algorithms.


Develop, improve, and deploy Dynamic Pricing models.
Design optimization approaches that maximize revenue while delivering customer value.
Analyze customer behavior, booking patterns, competitive dynamics, and market conditions.
Collaborate with Product Managers to translate business opportunities into analytical solutions.
Work closely with engineers to operationalize models in production environments.
Design experiments and evaluate business impact.
Contribute to the broader evolution of Revenue Management, pricing, forecasting, and optimization capabilities at SAS.
Help define the future analytical agenda of Revenue Management and Network Optimization Science.


The Team

You’ll join a high-performing and diverse team of talented professionals with a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. As our Dynamic Pricing team continues to grow, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to its development and help shape the way we work. We value collaboration, curiosity and innovation, and foster an inclusive environment where people support one another, share ideas and succeed together.

To be successful we believe you have

You enjoy solving complex business problems using quantitative methods and have a strong desire to create measurable business impact.

We Believe You Have


MSc or PhD in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience applying analytical methods to real-world business problems.
Strong programming skills in Python, R, SQL, or equivalent.
Ability to structure ambiguity and translate business questions into analytical approaches.
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.


Nice To Have


Experience with Pricing, Revenue Management, Forecasting, Optimization, or Decision Science.
Experience developing Machine Learning models in production environments.
Familiarity with airline, travel, retail, e-commerce, mobility, or marketplace industries.
Experience with experimentation and causal inference.
Knowledge of Operations Research techniques including optimization, simulation, or forecasting.


Why SAS?

Benefits

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:


Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

We welcome diverse perspectives and particularly encourage applications from women.

Additional Information


Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
Desired start date: As soon as possible.
Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period.
This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite. Remote work and employment in Copenhagen may also be options, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
To be eligible for this position you need an EU-work permit. Please note that we ask you to inform us if you currently have a valid EU-work permit.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist




Business-Focused | Marketing Analytics | High Ownership | Scale-Up Environment




We’re partnering with a fast-growing, data-driven company that is expanding its Data Science team. This is an opportunity to join a highly collaborative environment where data plays a central role in shaping commercial and marketing decisions.




This is not an ML engineering role.




We’re looking for a business-oriented Data Scientist who thrives on solving real commercial problems - someone who can translate ambiguity into structure and turn data into measurable value.




Why this role is exciting?

You’ll work directly with senior stakeholders and marketing teams.
You’ll build new capabilities in an area that’s still largely untapped.
You won’t be siloed in an isolated data team - you’ll operate as a strategic partner.
You’ll have the autonomy to define problems, shape solutions, and influence outcomes.
You’ll join a lean, collaborative environment where impact matters more than hierarchy.




If you enjoy working hands-on, owning problems end-to-end, and seeing your work drive commercial outcomes - this will suit you well.




What you’ll be doing?

Translating business and marketing challenges into structured data science problems
Defining success metrics and measurable impact
Designing and executing analytical approaches (segmentation, prediction, experimentation, optimisation)
Working closely with commercial and marketing stakeholders
Communicating insights clearly to non-technical audiences
Contributing to both new marketing initiatives and existing ML use cases




You’ll be treated as a thought partner - not just someone who “builds models.”




What we’re looking for?

Core Profile

2+ years of experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role
Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative field (Master’s preferred)
Confident in Python for data analysis and modelling
Experience turning vague business questions into structured analytical solutions
Ability to clearly explain complex ideas to non-technical stakeholders




You’ll likely thrive here if:

You enjoy smaller, agile environments over large corporate silos
You’ve worked close to marketing, growth, or commercial teams
You care about measurable business impact - not just model accuracy
You take initiative rather than waiting for detailed instructions
You’re comfortable operating with ambiguity
You prefer ownership over rigid structure




Bonus Points for

Marketing analytics or performance marketing exposure
Experience measuring campaign performance or customer segmentation
A/B testing and experimentation experience
Cloud familiarity
Experience working in companies where Data Science is embedded in business teams rather than isolated




This role is probably not for you if:

You’re primarily an ML engineer focused on deployment, infrastructure, or MLOps
You prefer highly defined tickets over open-ended problem solving

You’ll join an established Data Science function working alongside experienced colleagues. The team balances traditional ML use cases with new marketing-focused initiatives - and this hire is key to scaling that capability.

Your thinking matters as much as your technical skills

You help build new data capabilities from the ground up
You grow alongside a scaling, ambitious team




If you’re a problem solver who enjoys bridging business and data - we’d love to speak with you.

Title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist (French speaking)
Description:
About the role




This week CNN and Reuters reported on our work in DRC together with Vodacom, WHO, Congo government, African CDC and other where we are using mobile-phone data to understand population movements and get ahead of the Ebola outbreak. This is part of Flowminder's work, and we need one more person on the team doing it.




You'll turn mobile operator, survey and spatial data into population and mobility statistics that ministries of health, national statistics offices and UN agencies rely on for outbreak response, humanitarian planning and development decision-making in DRC and beyond. About a third of the role is training and building capacity with our partner institutions, in French and English, including travel to the countries we work in. It's a job where what you produce on a Tuesday can shape decisions on the ground by Friday.




We're looking for someone with a strong quantitative background, solid Python and time-series skills, spatial data experience, and professional working French.

Permanent, full-time, based in Stockholm or Southampton (hybrid).

Deadline: 30 September 2026. We review on a rolling basis.




Full details and how to apply: https://lnkd.in/d2eff96M




About Flowminder

Flowminder is a non-profit foundation. We enable decision makers to access the data they need to transform the lives of vulnerable people, at scale.

We analyse pseudonymised mobile operator data, satellite imagery and household survey data to measure where people are and how they move. Flowminder researchers were the first to use mobile operator data to track population movements after a large-scale disaster and during a major infectious disease outbreak, following the 2010 Haiti earthquake and cholera outbreak. We work with national statistics offices, health ministries and disaster management agencies in low- and middle-income countries, alongside UN agencies, the World Bank and development banks.

We are a small team, based mainly in Southampton and Stockholm, working in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Haiti, Ghana and Pakistan. Our working language is English, but much of our work with partners is in French.

Title: Senior/Lead Data Scientist -Credit & Finance Model Validation
Description:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances. Working here means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else — you'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About The Role

Klarna runs more than 200 predictive and AI/LLM models across credit scoring, fraud detection, AML/CTF, finance, and operations — and five people are responsible for independently challenging every one of them. You'd be the sixth, joining model risk within Risk Control to own model risk policy and governance and to review and challenge the models built by teams across the business.

The team, led by Edward McAvoy, has depth in software engineering and model development, but limited experience in credit risk and underwriting, and in provisioning, impairment, and IFRS9 modelling for finance. That's the specific gap this position closes: you'll bring hands-on model-building experience in those areas and use it to independently challenge models built by the first line.

Given the ratio of models to reviewers, you won't have time to check every model with equal depth. You'll need to identify which parts of a model carry the most risk and concentrate your challenge there, and you'll help build the code base and AI tooling that lets the team scale its coverage rather than working through the backlog line by line.

What You'll Do


You'll independently review and challenge predictive and AI/LLM models built by the first line, across credit scoring, fraud detection, AML/CTF, finance (including impairments), and operations.
You'll work directly with model developers and business users to pinpoint control weaknesses in how models are built and used, and follow through until they're fixed.
You'll extend the team's code base and AI tooling so more of Klarna's models can be challenged, and challenged more deeply, without adding headcount.
You'll help decide which models and model risks get the team's limited validation time, prioritizing by risk rather than working through the queue in order.
You'll draw on your own experience building models to test whether a model's assumptions, data, and methodology hold up, not just whether its documentation does.


Who You Are


You've hands-on experience building predictive models for credit risk or underwriting — you've sat on the first line, not just reviewed someone else's work from the second.
You understand provisioning, impairment, and IFRS9 modelling well enough to assess how a finance model estimates losses, not just how it's coded.
You're proficient in Python and SQL for building, running, and interrogating models.
You can work independently with model developers and business stakeholders, challenge their assumptions, and push back on weak controls even when that's an uncomfortable conversation.
You can prioritize which risks in a model matter most, rather than trying to check everything with equal depth.


Bonus points for


You've validated or independently challenged models before, ideally from a second-line risk function.
You have hands-on experience with PySpark for distributed data processing.
You've worked with cloud platforms such as AWS.


Things you should know before applying


This position is open in both Stockholm and London; you'll work from whichever location you're hired into.
Depending on your experience, this position will be leveled as Senior Data Scientist or Lead Data Scientist.
Validation windows for individual models are tight, so you'll need to focus your challenge on a model's riskiest aspects rather than reviewing it end to end.
Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.


Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost.

Title: Data Scientists AI-team
Description:
Vi söker en Data Scientists som vill förvandla data till en strategisk resurs och skapa insikter som gör skillnad. Vill du arbeta med hela processen, från att samla in och kvalitetssäkra data till att analysera, modellera och utveckla AI-lösningar som ger verksamheten bättre beslutsunderlag? Då kan detta vara rätt uppdrag för dig!



Om oss



Region Stockholm är ledande inom life science, forskning och innovation i Sverige. Life science spelar en avgörande roll i utvecklingen av nya medicinska behandlingar och bioteknologiska innovationer, vilket bidrar till förbättrad hälsa och livskvalitet. Forskningen fokuserar främst på att förbättra vården och livskvaliteten för invånarna, samt att göra verksamheter mer hållbara. Innovationsprojekt syftar till att utveckla nya produkter och tjänster inom hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik och regional planering i syfte att förenkla och förbättra patientvården och andra tjänster för regionens invånare.



Arbetet för att stärka Region Stockholms förmåga till en ansvarsfull användning av AI inom life science, forskning och innovation fortsätter under 2025 genom inrättandet av ett regionalt AI-team, ett team med utvecklingskompetens inom AI som ska arbeta med AI-initiativ inom hälsovård, trafik, kultur och regional utveckling. Initiativet ska stärka den egna kompetensen inom egenutveckling och upphandling av AI både centralt och lokalt inom regionen.



AI-teamet tillhör avdelningen Strategisk IT på regionledningskontoret, vars uppdrag är att styra, utveckla, följa upp och samordna it, digitalisering och informationssäkerhet på strategisk nivå för hela Region Stockholm. Ett arbete som bedrivs i nära dialog och samarbete med förvaltningar och bolag. 



Om tjänsten



Som Data Scientist i Region Stockholms AI-team gör du data till en strategisk resurs genom att hantera hela kedjan – från insamling och kvalitetssäkring till analys, modellering och visualisering. Du utvecklar prediktiva modeller och AI-lösningar som ger bättre beslutsunderlag och skapar rapporter som gör komplexa insikter begripliga.



Rollen omfattar även ett ansvar för datakvalitet, integritet och efterlevnad av lagar som GDPR, samt dokumentation av metoder och resultat för transparens och återanvändning. Du höjer organisationens datamognad genom rådgivning, leder projekt som förbättrar datainfrastruktur och analyskapacitet, utvecklar verktyg, automatiserar processer och tar fram strategiska underlag.



Arbetet sker i nära samverkan med IT, juridik och verksamhetsutveckling för att säkerställa korrekt och ansvarsfull användning av data, samtidigt som du bidrar till teamets effektivitet och samarbete.



Vem är du?

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
TL;DR

We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer / Data Scientist who loves building and shipping features. You’ll take big ownership of Magma’s AI projects, prototype fast, deploy models to production, and help improve math learning for millions of students. Stockholm-based, full-time, 5 days in office.

About Magma Math

Magma is one of the world’s fastest-growing and most celebrated edtech companies, transforming math education through the power of AI. Our platform turns handwritten solutions into digital insights, empowering teachers to focus on creativity and deeper learning while giving them real-time visibility into student progress.

The result? More inclusive, engaging, and effective math classrooms for all learners.

But we’re not just building better tools. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in global education: math underperformance. With 1 in 5 students globally struggling in math, a subject that forms the backbone of so many career paths, we believe the opportunity to improve outcomes at scale is massive.

We’re already the go-to solution in thousands of schools and we’re just getting started. As we expand rapidly across the U.S. and Europe, we’re building a team as ambitious as our mission: to help millions of students unlock their full potential in math.

The Role

We are looking for builders that want to work with large data sets, build AI-powered products and ship things that make a real difference for teachers and students. In this role you will take large ownership of Magma’s AI initiatives, from research and prototyping to production and iteration, working together with product and engineering.

Your Work Will Span Across Areas Such As


Digging into data, building models, pipelines and AI-powered systems
Building AI agents and agentic workflows
Prototyping quickly and iterating based on real classroom feedback and measurable impact
Deploying and monitoring models in production, improving quality, speed and reliability over time
Leverage AI to scale both the product and the business
Working closely with the team to define what “great” looks like for AI in education, and pushing the product forward fast
This is a high-ownership role where you’ll be expected to move quickly, explore new ideas, and turn the best ones into real product improvements that are used by students every day


Who You Are And What You Know

We are searching for a team member who wants to take large ownership of Magma's different AI projects. To succeed you need to:


Be passionate about building stuff with big impact
Have a big interest in AI, stay up-to-date with the latest releases and enjoy experimenting
Be very ambitious and like chasing challenging targets
Be extremely output-oriented and find satisfaction in driving projects to completion
Eager to learn new things, and have experience of building stuff
Great at communicating
Be hardworking and willing to join a fast-paced and rapidly growing startup


Requirements


Coding skills that enable you to build stuff
Strong technical skills
Hands-on experience vibe coding with AI tools
Fluent in English


Our tech stack


Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript
AI & LLMs: multiple LLM providers, Langfuse for evaluation and observability
Infrastructure: AWS
AI development: Claude Code, Cursor and other AI-native development tools


Our stack evolves quickly and we care more about using the right tools and shipping great systems than any specific framework.

What We Offer


Play a key role in an exciting journey. We are a young company with ambitious targets and meaningful goals
Fantastic colleagues in a fun environment with great opportunities to learn develop your skills
Competitive salary and benefits
An opportunity to work on a meaningful mission and have an exceptional impact on education, society, and how children learn math across the world
Travel and meet users and colleagues around the world


Location: Stockholm, Sweden.

Note: We practice a 5 day in office policy, and we look forward to working together closely with you :)

Our Recruitment Process

A call with the Hiring Manager.

1st interview with Hiring Manager and People team member.

2nd interview with Hiring Manager and Magma team member.

3rd interview with CPO and Magma team member.

Your Work Will Span Across Areas Such As

  • Digging into data, building models, pipelines and AI-powered systems
  • Building AI agents and agentic workflows
  • Prototyping quickly and iterating based on real classroom feedback and measurable impact
  • Deploying and monitoring models in production, improving quality, speed and reliability over time
  • Leverage AI to scale both the product and the business
  • Working closely with the team to define what “great” looks like for AI in education, and pushing the product forward fast
  • This is a high-ownership role where you’ll be expected to move quickly, explore new ideas, and turn the best ones into real product improvements that are used by students every day

Who You Are And What You Know

We are searching for a team member who wants to take large ownership of Magma's different AI projects. To succeed you need to:

  • Be passionate about building stuff with big impact
  • Have a big interest in AI, stay up-to-date with the latest releases and enjoy experimenting
  • Be very ambitious and like chasing challenging targets
  • Be extremely output-oriented and find satisfaction in driving projects to completion
  • Eager to learn new things, and have experience of building stuff
  • Great at communicating
  • Be hardworking and willing to join a fast-paced and rapidly growing startup

Requirements

  • Coding skills that enable you to build stuff
  • Strong technical skills
  • Hands-on experience vibe coding with AI tools
  • Fluent in English

Our tech stack

  • Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript
  • AI & LLMs: multiple LLM providers, Langfuse for evaluation and observability
  • Infrastructure: AWS
  • AI development: Claude Code, Cursor and other AI-native development tools

Our stack evolves quickly and we care more about using the right tools and shipping great systems than any specific framework.

What we offer

  • Play a key role in an exciting journey. We are a young company with ambitious targets and meaningful goals
  • Fantastic colleagues in a fun environment with great opportunities to learn develop your skills
  • Competitive salary and benefits
  • An opportunity to work on a meaningful mission and have an exceptional impact on education, society, and how children learn math across the world
  • Travel and meet users and colleagues around the world

Location: Stockholm, Sweden.

Note: We practice a 5 day in office policy, and we look forward to working together closely with you :)

Our Recruitment Process

A call with the Hiring Manager.

1st interview with Hiring Manager and People team member.

2nd interview with Hiring Manager and Magma team member.

3rd interview with CPO and Magma team member.

Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Försäkringskassan har kommit långt i sin tillämpning av analys och AI i syfte att motverka bidragsbrott och felaktiga utbetalningar. Vi arbetar med stora mängder interna och externa data samlat på ett omfattande och strukturerat data warehouse. Vårt datalager är bland de största i Norden.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med riskvärdering och programmering. Främst handlar det om att ta fram urval till kontroll men vi arbetar även med att automatisera och förbättra myndighetens handläggning. Du bör ha arbetslivserfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data samt kombinera data från olika källor.

Du kommer jobba främst i SAS EG (low-code) och SAS Viya. För att kunna ha en hög förvaltningsbarhet på våra produkter är det viktigt att arbetet utförs enligt vår arbetsprocess, där man följer den standard och de arbetsrutiner som vi har tagit fram. Detta inkluderar även dokumentation av produkten. Arbetet är omväxlande och du kommer i kontakt med stora delar av Försäkringskassans verksamhet.

Tjänsten innebär att du hanterar sekretessbelagda uppgifter vilket ställer höga krav på rätt hantering. Därför är det viktigt att du som ska arbeta hos oss har högt säkerhetsmedvetande.

Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar.

Vi söker dig som


har högskolexamen inom matematik, statistik, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer som likvärdig som t.ex. en ingenjörsutbildning
har god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data
har erfarenhet av analysarbete med kvantitativa metoder
har goda kunskaper i relevanta analysmetoder och programmeringsspråk som exempelvis SAS och SQL
agerar på eget initiativ och tar ansvar för att nå goda resultat
har ett systematiskt och noggrant arbetssätt
kan förstå och analysera komplexa frågor
samarbetar effektivt med andra för att nå gemensamma mål
har god kommunikativ förmåga.


Det Är Meriterande Om Du


har erfarenhet av avancerad dataanalys
har erfarenhet från arbete inom socialförsäkringen eller annan myndighet
har mycket god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data från Försäkringskassans datalager
har erfarenhet av att använda SAS EG, SAS EM, SAS STP eller motsvarande i SAS Viya.


Övrigt

En tjänst, tillsvidare, heltid, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan bli aktuellt. Vissa anställningar hos oss innebär deltagande i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet. För att bli anställd i en sådan tjänst krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).

I enlighet med Försäkringskassans riktlinje för säkerhet genomförs bakgrundskontroller i denna rekrytering. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns om arbetet tillåter. I den här rekryteringen kan arbetspsykologiska test och arbetsprov användas som en del i urvalsarbetet. Placeringsort: Stockholm eller Uppsala.

Chef: Pål Wilkens 010-116 22 35 (för frågor om tjänsten). HR-specialist: Fanny Secher, fanny.secher@fk.se (för frågor om rekryteringsprocessen). ST: Henrik Lindholm 010-116 92 35, Saco-S: Annika Linell 010-114 79 54, Seko: Johanna Grundström 010-115 30 44.

Title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla modeller som har direkt påverkan på affären? Nu söker vi på Marginalen Bank en kvantitativ analytiker till vårt team Kredit & Analys.




I rollen blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av bankens statistiska modeller. Du arbetar med modellutveckling genom hela livscykeln, från kreditriskmodeller och scorekort till riskklassificering och beräkning av förväntade kreditförluster enligt IFRS 9. Här får du kombinera avancerad analytisk problemlösning med ett nära samarbete över flera delar av verksamheten.




Om teamet

Du blir en del av ett agilt team bestående av teamlead, analytiker och kvantitativa analytiker, där kunskapsdelning, utveckling och innovation står högt på agendan.

De modeller vi utvecklar och förvaltar utgör grunden för bankens kreditbedömningar, riskhantering och reserveringar, vilket gör teamets arbete avgörande för både lönsamhet och hållbar tillväxt.




Om jobbet

Som senior kvantitativ analytiker kommer du bland annat att:




Driva utveckling och vidareutveckling av kreditriskmodeller inom områden som A-score, B-score och IFRS 9.
Ansvara för hela modellutvecklingsprocessen, från dataanalys och metodval till modellering, kalibrering, testning och implementering.
Bidra med expertkunskap inom statistiska och matematiska modeller samt stötta och coacha kollegor i metodrelaterade frågor.
Samarbeta nära modellägare, modellanvändare och intressenter inom Kredit, Finans, Riskkontroll och affärsverksamheten.
Delta i förvaltning, monitorering och regelbundna produktionskörningar av modeller.




Vi tror att du...

är en erfaren analytiker som trivs med att ta ansvar, driva utveckling framåt och omsätta komplexa frågeställningar till affärsnytta. Du kombinerar ett starkt tekniskt kunnande med förmågan att se helheten och kommunicera dina insikter på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt.




För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

Minst 4-5 års erfarenhet av kreditriskmodellering eller liknande analytiskt arbete.
God kunskap inom statistiska metoder relevanta för kreditriskmodeller.
Erfarenhet av programmering i Python och/eller R.
Goda kunskaper inom SQL eller motsvarande databashantering.
Erfarenhet från bank, finanssektorn eller konsultverksamhet.
Akademisk examen inom exempelvis statistik, matematik, ekonomi, teknik eller annat relevant område.




Som person är du:

Initiativtagande och självgående med ett starkt eget driv.
Analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att navigera i komplexa frågeställningar.
Van att identifiera risker och omvandla dem till konkreta förbättringsförslag.
Generös med din kunskap och uppskattar att samarbeta och utveckla andra.
En skicklig kommunikatör som kan göra avancerade analyser begripliga för olika målgrupper.




Vad du får hos oss

Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad. Vi är en prestigelös organisation där beslut fattas nära verksamheten och där goda idéer snabbt kan bli verklighet. Vi arbetar agilt, uppmuntrar initiativ och tror på att ge våra medarbetare stort eget ansvar.




Du blir en del av ett engagerat team där kunskapsdelning, innovation och samarbete är en naturlig del av vardagen.




Vårt huvudkontor ligger mitt i centrala Stockholm, den ikoniska byggnaden ritad av Sigurd Lewerentz. Dessutom har vi en egen restaurang med kock som lagar ekologisk mat varje dag.




Vi erbjuder bland annat:




Flexibelt arbetssätt
Tjänstepension
Hälsoförsäkring
Friskvårdsbidrag
Volontärdag
Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter
En kultur präglad av engagemang, samarbete och arbetsglädje




Låter det som nästa steg i din karriär?




Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 30 september. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Title: SVT söker Data Analyst med AI-fokus
Description:
Vad Vi Erbjuder Dig

Vårt uppdrag är att göra innehåll som är tillgängligt för alla, oavsett var i landet man bor eller vem man är. Hos oss arbetar du med en av Sveriges mest uppskattade streamingtjänster som dagligen används av miljontals människor, i både stora och små stunder i livet. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och tvärfunktionellt team som arbetar med ny teknik i en kreativ och utvecklande miljö, där vi samarbetar för att förstå våra användare och utveckla våra tjänster. Vi ger dig möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom data, analys och AI i det dagliga arbetet. Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk utveckling med problemlösning och dina insikter blir en del av hur vi utvecklar SVT Play.

Vad Den Här Tjänsten Innebär

Som Dataanalytiker kommer du att arbeta med att utforska och analysera data för att skapa insikter som driver produktutveckling framåt. Du kommer att ingå i vårt SVT Konto-team där vi arbetar med att utveckla och förbättra ett gemensamt kontoskapande som används i alla våra tjänster. Det är ett strategiskt viktigt område för oss, med stor påverkan på användarupplevelsen och vår fortsatta tillväxt. Teamet är korsfunktionellt där idéer och initiativ uppmuntras och tas vidare i arbetsgruppen som består av analytiker, utvecklare, produktägare, designers och UX.

Samtidigt ingår du i vårt analysteam där ni jobbar nära varandra och delar ansvar för vår datadomän. I analytikerrollen arbetar du längs hela analyskedjan: du bygger och underhåller datamodeller i dbt, säkerställer datakvalité och implementerar tracking, utforskar stora datamängder, designar och analyserar experiment, tar fram insikter och kommunicerar resultat genom visualiseringar och dashboards. Du är en naturlig brygga mellan data och beslut, och trivs med att arbeta nära och samarbeta med olika team, roller och kollegor.

Vem Vi Tror Att Du Är

I din roll som analytiker integrerar du AI som en självklar del av ditt dagliga arbete för att utforska frågeställningar, utveckla lösningar och effektivisera analysprocesser. Du använder AI i programmering, analys och idéarbete, och bygger gärna verktyg och flöden som gör data och insikter mer tillgängliga för fler. Du kombinerar teknisk nyfikenhet med god statistisk förståelse och omdöme, och säkerställer att AI-assisterade analyser är relevanta, korrekta och möjliga att validera. Du hittar möjligheter i ny teknik, pushar oss framåt och driver initiativ som utvecklar vårt sätt att arbeta med data.

Du har förmågan att formulera hypoteser och ta arbetet framåt från data till insikt. Du analyserar data strukturerat och följer upp resultat på ett sätt som gör dem användbara i beslut.

Du är skicklig på att kommunicera insikter genom storytelling och visualisering, och gör komplex data begriplig för olika målgrupper. Vi söker dig som genuint uppskattar att samarbeta och söka olika perspektiv för att lösa problem tillsammans. Du är van att arbeta i datadrivna processer och har kunskap om A/B-testning.

Vi Söker Dig Som


Behärskar SQL och Python
Har erfarenhet av datamodellering och semantiska lager, samt kännedom om verktyg som exempelvis Git, BigQuery och dbt
Ligger i framkant vad gäller AI-verktyg och hur AI kan användas i analysarbetet
Har erfarenhet av att använda LLM:er som en del av ditt analysarbete, samt en god förståelse för dess styrkor och begränsningar
Praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga analysflöden med LLM:er
Har erfarenhet av explorativ analys och att arbeta hypotesdrivet med data
Har erfarenhet av att arbete med datakvalité, validering och felsökning
Har vana vid att visualisera och kommunicera data genom exempelvis visualiseringsverktyg

Du blir en del av ett engagerat och tvärfunktionellt team som arbetar med ny teknik i en kreativ och utvecklande miljö, där vi samarbetar för att förstå våra användare och utveckla våra tjänster. Vi ger dig möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom data, analys och AI i det dagliga arbetet. Som Dataanalytiker kommer du att arbeta med att utforska och analysera data för att skapa insikter som driver produktutveckling framåt. Det är ett strategiskt viktigt område för oss, med stor påverkan på användarupplevelsen och vår fortsatta tillväxt. Teamet är korsfunktionellt där idéer och initiativ uppmuntras och tas vidare i arbetsgruppen som består av analytiker, utvecklare, produktägare, designers och UX.

Samtidigt ingår du i vårt analysteam där ni jobbar nära varandra och delar ansvar för vår datadomän. I din roll som analytiker integrerar du AI som en självklar del av ditt dagliga arbete för att utforska frågeställningar, utveckla lösningar och effektivisera analysprocesser. Du använder AI i programmering, analys och idéarbete, och bygger gärna verktyg och flöden som gör data och insikter mer tillgängliga för fler. Du kombinerar teknisk nyfikenhet med god statistisk förståelse och omdöme, och säkerställer att AI-assisterade analyser är relevanta, korrekta och möjliga att validera. Du hittar möjligheter i ny teknik, pushar oss framåt och driver initiativ som utvecklar vårt sätt att arbeta med data.

Du har förmågan att formulera hypoteser och ta arbetet framåt från data till insikt. Du analyserar data strukturerat och följer upp resultat på ett sätt som gör dem användbara i beslut.

Du är skicklig på att kommunicera insikter genom storytelling och visualisering, och gör komplex data begriplig för olika målgrupper. Vi söker dig som genuint uppskattar att samarbeta och söka olika perspektiv för att lösa problem tillsammans. Du är van att arbeta i datadrivna processer och har kunskap om A/B-testning.

Title: AI/ML-utvecklare
Description:
Är du en erfaren AI/ML-utvecklare som vill utveckla och produktionssätta lösningar som gör skillnad på riktigt? Då kan du vara en bra match för oss på Softhouse!

Vad vi kommer att göra tillsammans 🧑‍💻

Som AI/ML-utvecklare på Softhouse hjälper du våra kunder att planera, bygga och realisera sina AI/ML-projekt i olika leveranser och kunduppdrag. Du tar helhetsansvar för maskininlärningsmodellers livscykel, från datainsamling och utveckling, till utvärdering och stabil driftsättning i produktion.

Vårt AI-team arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans i leveranser och träffas regelbundet för att diskutera utmaningar och dela kunskap. Här ges du utrymme och möjlighet att vara med och utveckla Softhouse erbjudande inom AI samt skapa värde och driva innovation för våra kunder.

Vad vi söker hos dig 📌

På Softhouse värdesätter vi vår konsultmässighet högt. För oss handlar det inte bara om dina tekniska färdigheter, utan också om att du är kommunikativ, lyhörd och driven med förmåga att bygga förtroende hos våra kunder.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har minst 3 års erfarenhet inom:


AI/ML-utveckling i Python
Implementering och produktionssättning av maskininlärningsmodeller.
Hela ML-livscykeln, från datainsamling och utveckling, till modellträning, utvärdering och driftsättning.


Vi tror att du har en masterexamen eller PhD inom Teknisk Matematik, Teknisk Fysik, Datateknik, Elektroteknik eller motsvarande. Då konsultrollen innebär mycket kundkontakt krävs det att du är flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av MLOps, on-premises-implementering och driftsättning av AI-lösningar, samt hantering av stora datamängder.

Lite av vad vi erbjuder 🤝


Ett stabilt och välmående bolag där du och din work-life balance är i fokus
En mix av spännande inhouseprojekt och teamleveranser tillsammans med dina Softhouse-kollegor samt externa uppdrag
Skräddarsydd utvecklingsplan och aktiv kunskapsdelning med andra Softhouse-kollegor
Ett team som gillar att göra saker tillsammans för att förhöja vardagen - allt från hälsofrämjande aktiviteter till gemensamma frukostar och aw’s
Ett värderingsstyrt bolag där vi alla känner igen oss i våra värdeord: Team, Enkelhet, Mod och Passion


Lite mer om oss på Softhouse! 🏡

På Softhouse är vi ca 300 medarbetare fördelade på 8 orter i Sverige och ett kontor i Sarajevo. I Stockholm hittar du oss på Tegnérgatan, högst upp i en härlig vindsvåning, där vi är närmare 40 kollegor. I Uppsala huserar våra konsulter på Svartbäcksgatan med utsikt över Domkyrkan. Vi har kodat mjukvara sedan 1996, och arbetar tillsammans varje dag för att skapa lösningar som motsvarar våra kunders behov och överträffar deras förväntningar.

Låter det intressant? Vårt urval sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer

Location: Solna, Stockholm, Sweden

Start Date: 1st October 2026

End Date: 31st March 2027

Work Style: Monday - Friday / Hybrid, 40 Hours Weekly




Role Objective

Support the Power Forecasts product team in producing local-grid and regional-grid forecasts for housing, transport electrification, industry, and commercial premises.
Maintain and improve a data-driven, automated forecasting workflow centred on Python scripts.
Produce reliable forecasts and insights for network dimensioning, network-development planning, investment decisions, and customer dialogue.
Enhance the quality, efficiency, and analytical value of forecasting, data-modelling, and reporting processes.




Key Responsibilities

Automate forecasting activities previously completed manually using Python within a Databricks environment.
Analyse customer and time-series data to develop improved forecasting methodologies.
Build new Power BI reports and enhance existing reports through data modelling, calculations, and additional functionality.
Update power forecasts for specific geographical areas and generate quantitative and qualitative insights.
Assess data availability, combine information from multiple sources, and ensure data quality and reliability.
Communicate analytical findings clearly to internal and external stakeholders.




Tasks

Develop clear and efficient Python code to automate forecast preparation and processing.
Conduct both defined analyses and exploratory investigations into customer and time-series data.
Collaborate with colleagues from other disciplines to assess potential changes to forecasting methodology.
Develop Power BI data models, calculations, visualisations, and report functionality.
Gather, validate, process, and quality-assure input data used in power forecasts.
Liaise with municipalities and local-grid customers when updating forecasts for specific areas.
Prepare and present forecast results, insights, and supporting materials to relevant stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous development of automated and data-driven ways of working within the product team.




Deliverables

Automated and maintainable forecasting workflows within Databricks.
Updated local-grid and regional-grid power forecasts.
Customer-data and time-series analyses supporting methodology development.
Accurate and usable Power BI reports, data models, and calculations.
Quality-assured datasets, analytical insights, and stakeholder presentation materials.




Decision Authority / Responsibility

Own assigned analysis, automation, reporting, and forecast-update activities through to completion.
Recommend improvements to forecasting methodologies, data models, and automated workflows based on evidence and analysis.
Identify and escalate material data-quality, reliability, and methodological risks.
Ensure analytical results and reporting outputs are clear, reliable, and suitable for stakeholder decision-making.




Requirements

Several years of experience analysing large datasets, particularly customer data and time series, including data manipulation, modelling, and presentation of results to stakeholders.
Several years of experience developing efficient, understandable code using Python or a comparable programming language.
Professional experience in the electricity-network sector or other relevant energy-industry experience.
Professional experience with data-visualisation tools such as Power BI.
Strong analytical ability and advanced problem-solving skills.
Able to communicate complex findings and messages clearly to different stakeholders.
Relevant academic degree, such as an MSc in Engineering in Applied Physics, Energy Systems, Electrical Power Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
Previous experience in insight generation and/or forecasting is advantageous.
Experience working in an Agile Scrum team or equivalent environment is advantageous.
Experience with artificial intelligence and machine learning is advantageous.
Experience with SQL or an equivalent query language is advantageous.

Title: Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst | SEB, Stockholm
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst to join the Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team in SEB. The job offers an exciting mix of analytical challenges and professional development opportunities: working with big data, developing credit risk models, understanding and abiding to regulatory constraints and explaining complex models to stakeholders on all levels across the Bank. You will be part of a dedicated, expert team with broad exposure across the bank and excellent prospects for personal and career growth.

About The Role

The Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling team is in the CRO organization in SEB. Credit Risk covers IRB, IFRS9, and stress testing models across all jurisdictions and legal entities of SEB Group. As a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst in the Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team, you will be building and maintaining models that lie at the core of SEB’s risk management and capital framework.

As a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst, you will:


Explore large and complex datasets to uncover patterns and gain insights into credit risk behaviour
Develop, enhance and maintain models that support credit decisions, capital adequacy and pricing strategies
Participate in regulatory and internal model development projects, collaborating with experienced quants and credit risk experts
Present analysis and findings to internal stakeholders in risk, business and credit functions
Help ensure models are used effectively by supporting their implementation in production and contributing to documentation and governance processes


You will have the opportunity to develop a deep understanding of quantitative risk modelling in banking, while continuously building your technical and professional skills in a supportive and intellectually stimulating environment.

The role is based in Stockholm.

You will thrive in this role if you:

are curious about data, modelling and credit risk, and enjoy using analytical thinking to solve complex problems. You take a structured and solution-oriented approach to your work and are motivated by finding ways to improve processes and outcomes. As a collaborative team player, you enjoy sharing knowledge and working closely with others, while also taking ownership of your responsibilities. You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and feel comfortable explaining complex topics in an understandable way. We also value individuals who are willing to challenge ideas constructively and contribute to continuous improvement.

Your experience and background:


Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or similar
Hands-on experience working with data, analysis and modelling
Proficiency in Python
Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written


Meritorious experience:


Experience with SAS and/or SQL
Knowledge of credit risk modelling, including PD, LGD and EAD
Knowledge of credit risk regulations and supervisory guidelines, such as CRR and CRD
Knowledge of Swedish


Candidates for both junior and senior roles are encouraged to apply.

What We Offer


Friendly and welcoming culture
Challenging and interesting projects at the forefront of credit risk modelling
A supportive environment for learning, development and career progression
Attractive compensation and benefits


Do you want to be part of SEB?

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 20th of September 2026. If you have questions about the position, please contact Bujar Huskaj, Head of Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team, by mail bujar.huskaj@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.

Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.

Är nyexaminerad ingenjör, systemvetare eller ekonom med en masterexamen inom management eller data/data science/analytics.

CV

Title: Applied AI Engineer
Description:
The role

We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to own the definition, scaling, and expansion of AI/ML solutions at Redpine. Our mission is to be the leading knowledge layer for trusted AI data. You will develop and implement machine learning solutions that power our platform, so organizations can source, validate, and manage high-quality training and inference data.

You will be among the first key employees building algorithms for data quality assessment, automated validation and evaluation, and intelligent data matching. We interview on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application sooner rather than later.

What You'll Do


Design and implement machine learning models for data quality assessment and validation.
Develop algorithms for automated data labeling and annotation verification.
Create and maintain data processing pipelines for various AI training data types.
Develop and optimize matching algorithms between data providers and buyers.
Implement scalable solutions for processing and analyzing large datasets.
Collaborate with the product team to develop new features for the marketplace platform.
Research and implement state-of-the-art ML techniques for data quality improvement.
Work with customers and stakeholders to understand and implement data requirements for various AI use cases.


What we're looking for


Strong experience in developing, training, and deploying AI / Machine Learning models.
Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, R, Scala, Hugging Face).
Knowledge of model deployment techniques and serving frameworks like TensorFlow Serving, TorchServe, or custom APIs.
Experience with large-scale data processing and distributed computing.
Experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes, as well as version control tools such as Git.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable writing queries, exploring data, and collaborating on hypotheses with product and engineering counterparts.
Proficiency in independently setting up and managing cloud services that support scaling on a global level.
A Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning or similar is a plus.


Why this role

You will be one of the first people defining how Redpine uses ML on licensed data: quality, validation, matching, and evaluation. The work sits on the path between data owners and the models that consume that data.

Practical details


Based at Redpine HQ in central Stockholm. Office-first, with real autonomy for deep-work days and life admin.
Requires a valid Swedish work permit or similar eligibility. Relocation support available.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
Small team, high ownership. The same people design, ship, and run the systems.


About Redpine

If models were the first wave of AI, and compute the second, we are building the data layer that comes next. Only a small fraction of the world's data is on the open internet. The rest, high-quality, domain-specific, often critical, sits behind paywalls, in databases, or with rights holders. Redpine is building the infrastructure to unlock it.

We provide AI builders and autonomous agents with access to licensed, high-quality, multimodal data through a unified platform and API. The goal is simple: make AI systems more accurate, more useful, and grounded in real-world information.

You will work closely with the founding team, including Anders (ex-partner at VC, McKinsey) and David (ex-tech and product leader at Spotify, Zettle, and Lunar). We are backed by Nordic Ninja, Node VC, and Luminar, alongside angels from OpenAI, Spotify, and Perplexity.

If you are eager to make a meaningful impact in the AI space, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Title: AI Engineer till vårt Data-team - Ving
Description:
Vill du utveckla AI-lösningar som skapar verklig nytta – tillsammans med människor från olika delar av verksamheten? Vi söker en utåtriktad och samarbetsorienterad AI Engineer till vårt Data-team.

Om tjänsten

Som AI Engineer arbetar du med att utveckla, implementera och förbättra AI- och maskininlärningslösningar. Du blir en viktig länk mellan teknik och verksamhet och samarbetar med data engineers, nyckelpersoner i verksamheten, produktteam och plattformsteam.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:



Utveckla och produktionssätta AI- och ML-lösningar
Bygga applikationer på språkmodeller
Utveckla prognos- och beslutsstödsmodeller
Sätta upp evaluering och kvalitetsmätning så vi vet om en modell faktiskt fungerar, och märker när den slutar göra det
Möjliggöra integrationer/API:er som gör modellernas output användbar i våra system
Förklara tekniska möjligheter, alternativ och begränsningar på ett lättbegripligt sätt
Realisera idéer från experiment och prototyp till stabil lösning
Dela kunskap och bidra till våra teams tekniska utveckling inom AI & ML


Vår tekniska miljö

Vi är 13 utvecklingsteam på IT-avdelningen i Stockholm som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt. Teamen inom Data & Analytics som tillsammans bygger NLTG:s data-, analys- och AI-plattform på Microsoft Fabric.

Med Fabric Data Factory, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse och Fabric Data Science som grund utvecklar vi skalbara lösningar för data engineering, maskininlärning, avancerad analys och AI.

Vi arbetar med moderna tekniker som Python, MLflow, dbt, SQL, Power BI, Azure DevOps och Git. I linje med vår cloud-first-strategi utforskar vi även nästa generations AI-lösningar med Microsoft Foundry, där innovation, kvalitet och affärsvärde står i centrum.

I linje med vår cloud-first-strategi satsar vi på skalbara och framtidssäkra lösningar där innovation, prestanda och kvalitet alltid står i fokus.

Läs mer om vår IT-avdelning här 🧑‍💻

Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du är nyfiken, initiativrik och tycker om att lösa problem tillsammans med andra. Du är kommunikativ och utåtriktad, trivs med många kontaktytor och har lätt för att skapa förtroende. För dig är samarbete en självklar del av att bygga bra tekniska lösningar.

Vi ser gärna att du har:



Erfarenhet av AI och maskininlärning
Goda kunskaper i Python, SQL och relevanta AI-/ML-ramverk
Erfarenhet av molntjänster (helst Azure),CI/CD & IAC
Förståelse för data på djupet – modellering, kvalitet & pipelines
Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Foundry eller Azure ML.

Vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande miljö. Du får en omväxlande vardag tillsammans med härliga kollegor - vi arbetar i nära samarbete med andra team och verksamheten för att ge våra gäster de bästa veckorna på året. Vi har ett högt medarbetarengagemang och en härlig kultur. Vi älskar vårt jobb och välkomnar dig ombord på vår resa i Nordic Leisure Travel Group!

Läs mer om vad vi erbjuder här 🏄

Övrigt

Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst och placerad på Vings fina huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Det är möjligt med distansarbete upp till 2 dagar per vecka när det passar för teamet/arbetsuppgiften.

Kontakt: hakan.sandstrom@nltg.com 0709513226

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av tester från Alva Labs – ett logiskt problemlösningstest och ett personlighetstest. Testerna utgår från vedertagen forskning och ger oss möjlighet att på ett mer objektivt sätt bedöma dina styrkor och eventuella utmaningar i relation till aktuell tjänst. Du får mer information när du skickat in din ansökan, men om du är nyfiken redan nu kan du läsa mer hos Alva Labs .

Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetenhet. Innan ett beslut om anställning fattas kommer en bakgrundskontroll att genomföras.

🤝 Tjänstepension

🌎 Reseförmåner

🦉 Utveckling och lärande

💗 Well-being

💼 Hybrid arbetsplats

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise GTM
Description:
Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking — from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We're an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Come create with us, and let the world feel your work.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join an embedded, AI-native analytics team that sits inside the commercial and product domains driving our growth. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP of Revenue Operations and Global Sales Leadership as we scale our enterprise business — defining what success looks like across the full bow-tie funnel, from pipeline generation to expansion revenue, and proving it with data. You'll have a dedicated mandate within the Enterprise GTM org while drawing on the shared infrastructure, engineering support, and peers of our central Data & Analytics team.

What you'll do


Partner with RevOps and Sales leadership to define success metrics, surface growth opportunities across the enterprise bow-tie funnel, and shape GTM strategy with evidence — proactively raising the questions stakeholders haven't thought to ask.
Build and refine the models that steer the business — customer segmentation for territory and capacity planning, lead and account scoring for pipeline quality, and forecasting for pipeline and revenue.
Make our data trustworthy for agentic analytics — enrich context and metadata, and use AI coding tools to ship instrumentation and data-quality fixes directly so both people and AI tools can rely on it.
Own the analytical backbone of how the enterprise business is steered — KPI and metric definitions aligned across Sales, Marketing, and Finance, and the monthly, quarterly, and annual performance forums, owning the narrative, not just the slides.
Close data gaps and build scalable, self-serve measurement infrastructure so GTM teams can monitor long-term performance without you in the loop.
Uphold rigor as self-serve expands — push back on false precision in pipeline and forecast numbers, set the bar for what good analysis looks like, and resist sophistication, statistical or AI, where a simpler approach serves the decision better.


What you'll bring


Senior-level influence. You've driven real business impact by shaping decisions at the leadership level and moving revenue outcomes.
High agency. Habit of driving decisions through tailored communication and data storytelling.
Sharp analytical instincts. You scope vague questions with vetted frameworks, state hypotheses up front, and reason to a defensible answer even with imperfect data.
Sound judgement about data. A solid grasp of statistics and the discernment to know when past data predicts the future and when to override it for where the business is heading.
Technical versatility. Proficiency across SQL and Python (notebooks in Hex), dbt (on BigQuery), plus experience with AI coding tools and techniques including context engineering and evals.
PLG/SaaS fluency. Hands-on experience in product-led and SaaS businesses, with a solid grasp of subscription economics and the metrics that drive them.


Music to our ears


Experience across the B2B GTM funnel — Sales, Marketing, and RevOps — with funnel, segmentation, and forecasting analytics.
Data modelling know-how and experience with semantic layers.
A track record of defining metrics and steering frameworks for enterprise or 0→1 commercial motions.


What we'll offer


A fast-paced environment with real room for personal growth and tangible impact on the business.
The chance to help write the new playbook for running Analytics in the AI era, combining timeless principles with fresh learnings from emerging tooling.
A diverse, collaborative team of Analysts and Engineers building together.


Equal opportunity employer

We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.

Application

Ready to make the world feel your work? Please apply, in English.

Title: Senior Data Scientist — Data Cloud Acceleration
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

 

What you’ll do

Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset.  

Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data.  

Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate.  

Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates.  

Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services.  

Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations.  

Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences.  

Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work.  

Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results.  

Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery.  

 

What ownership looks like at this level

You are expected to own the deliverable. That means: 

Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component  

Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses  

Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring  

Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage  

Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business  

Raising risks and ambiguity early  

Leaving the work in a condition that another team member can operate or extend  

 

You will receive guidance on broader product direction, methodology, and complex stakeholder decisions, but you should not require step-by-step direction to complete the work. 

 

Experience that can set you up for success

These are useful indicators rather than absolute requirements: 

Experience applying statistical analysis and machine learning to real business problems  

Strong Python skills and familiarity with libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow  

Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets  

Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Athena, Hive, BigQuery, or similar technologies  

Experience developing classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, or anomaly-detection solutions  

Familiarity with model evaluation, experimental design, feature engineering, and statistical validation  

Experience creating repeatable batch-scoring workflows or exposing model outputs through APIs or services  

Familiarity with orchestration and automation tools such as Airflow, AWS Glue, Prefect, or similar platforms  

Experience using version control, testing, and reproducible development practices  

Ability to explain analytical results and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders  

Meaningful use of GenAI tools to improve the speed and quality of day-to-day work  

 

You’ll thrive here if you 

Are pragmatic. You select the simplest credible approach that can deliver useful business impact.  

Move quickly with discipline. You can produce an initial version rapidly while still validating the fundamentals.  

Care about trust. You check the data, question surprising results, and make limitations visible.  

Work well with ambiguity. You can turn an incomplete request into a clear set of questions, assumptions, and next steps.  

Think beyond the notebook. You consider how a model will be refreshed, accessed, demonstrated, monitored, and reused.  

Understand the business context. You evaluate technical decisions through the lens of client outcomes, revenue, cost, adoption, and decision quality.  

Are curious and low-ego. You are comfortable learning from others, revising an approach, and using an existing solution when it is better than building a new one.  

 

Early indicators of success 

Within the first several months, a successful candidate will have: 

Independently delivered a model, analysis workflow, or scoring component used in an active business or intelligence initiative  

Added repeatable validation and documentation to their deliverables  

Converted at least one exploratory analysis or prototype into a reusable workflow  

Demonstrated clear understanding of how their work supports a client, product, revenue, or operational outcome  

Used AI-assisted development to improve delivery speed without compromising accuracy or trust  

Earned confidence from data science, application, and business partners through reliable execution and clear communication 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

 

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here:  https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/ 

ZETA IN THE NEWS!

https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Twoday is one of the leading digital transformation partners in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 technologists, we collaborate with the most admired private and public organizations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our deep industry expertise includes Data & AI, software development, digital experiences, and business applications. Operating across the Nordics and Lithuania, our team serves over 8,000 customers and supporting their digital transformation journeys. 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our AI team!

Most organizations have no shortage of ideas for what to model. Far fewer can turn a vaguely stated business problem into a well-posed prediction task, pick the algorithmic approach that fits it, and defend the result when someone asks how the number was produced. That gap is where you come in. You will do the analytical work that turns a customer's business problem into a model that holds up, and then into something they actually use, alongside data engineers, AI/ML engineers, cloud architects, and software developers on some of the largest Data & AI teams in the Nordics.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time in data and in code, with experienced colleagues around you and room to take ownership of the analyses and models you know best.

What are we looking for?

You are a scientist and a builder. Given a business problem stated in a customer's own words, you can work out what should be predicted, at what granularity, against which target, and what a good result would even look like. You are rigorous about how you validate a result, and you have learned that the hard part is rarely the algorithm itself.

We expect you to bring:


Hands-on data science experience, including at least one or two models you have taken past the prototype stage and to production.
Experience translating a business objective into a formal AI/ML problem: defining the target variable and unit of analysis, agreeing what success means with the people who will use the model, and saying early when the data will not support the question.
Strong predictive modelling craft: classification, regression, time series and generative AI
Judgement about algorithmic choice: when a well-specified baseline or classical statistical model is enough or when a heavier method earns its cost and when the problem is not a prediction problem at all.
Solid applied statistics: honest validation, uncertainty, and the ability to explain what a result does and does not support.
Strong software fundamentals to write code others can build on
Experience on Azure: Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric (Experience from AWS or GCP transfers, and we will not hold it against you.)
Experience applying generative AI where it genuinely fits, including RAG architectures and the evaluation of prompts and models.
An awareness of what governance means in practice: reproducibility, model documentation, GDPR, and bias and fairness considerations. You do not need to have all the answers, but you should know the questions matter.
The ability to present your work to a customer's stakeholders and explain what you did and why, without flattening the trade-offs into a slogan.
Fluent spoken and written Danish is a requirement.


Will your responsibilities be?


Deliver the analytical work in customer projects: exploration, feature work, baselines, modelling, validation, and documentation.
Take part in framing sessions with customers and help shape a business problem into a prediction task with a defined target, a defined decision it supports, and success criteria the business recognises.
Propose and justify the algorithmic approach for the problems you own, starting from a baseline and adding complexity only where it pays.
Build models that hold up in production, together with our AI/ML engineers, and help interpret how they behave once they are live.
Choose and defend evaluation metrics that reflect the business outcome rather than only the leaderboard.
Work closely with customers' analysts and domain experts through delivery and handover.
Share what you know: code reviews, internal sessions, and pairing with less experienced colleagues.
Grow towards a lead role over time if that is the direction you want. We will support it.


About you


You take ownership and are comfortable working in complex environments
You are pragmatic and focus on delivering real-world value
You enjoy working across disciplines and bridging gaps within teams


What can we offer?

twoday is located in modern offices in 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will have a central role with exciting opportunities to develop in an international and innovative group, with exciting products and services within technology and software. You will also have the flexibility to "jump" and work from one of our headquarters in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, or Vilnius at times.

Diversity & Inclusion

Are you not meeting all the requirements listed? Studies have shown that women and other minority groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't meet every qualification. We're dedicated to build a workplace of diversity and inclusion. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience does not match the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.
