We expect you to bring:

  • Hands-on data science experience, including at least one or two models you have taken past the prototype stage and to production.
  • Experience translating a business objective into a formal AI/ML problem: defining the target variable and unit of analysis, agreeing what success means with the people who will use the model, and saying early when the data will not support the question.
  • Strong predictive modelling craft: classification, regression, time series and generative AI
  • Judgement about algorithmic choice: when a well-specified baseline or classical statistical model is enough or when a heavier method earns its cost and when the problem is not a prediction problem at all.
  • Solid applied statistics: honest validation, uncertainty, and the ability to explain what a result does and does not support.
  • Strong software fundamentals to write code others can build on
  • Experience on Azure: Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric (Experience from AWS or GCP transfers, and we will not hold it against you.)
  • Experience applying generative AI where it genuinely fits, including RAG architectures and the evaluation of prompts and models.
  • An awareness of what governance means in practice: reproducibility, model documentation, GDPR, and bias and fairness considerations. You do not need to have all the answers, but you should know the questions matter.
  • The ability to present your work to a customer's stakeholders and explain what you did and why, without flattening the trade-offs into a slogan.
  • Fluent spoken and written Danish is a requirement.

Will your responsibilities be?

  • Deliver the analytical work in customer projects: exploration, feature work, baselines, modelling, validation, and documentation.
  • Take part in framing sessions with customers and help shape a business problem into a prediction task with a defined target, a defined decision it supports, and success criteria the business recognises.
  • Propose and justify the algorithmic approach for the problems you own, starting from a baseline and adding complexity only where it pays.
  • Build models that hold up in production, together with our AI/ML engineers, and help interpret how they behave once they are live.
  • Choose and defend evaluation metrics that reflect the business outcome rather than only the leaderboard.
  • Work closely with customers' analysts and domain experts through delivery and handover.
  • Share what you know: code reviews, internal sessions, and pairing with less experienced colleagues.
  • Grow towards a lead role over time if that is the direction you want. We will support it.

About you

  • You take ownership and are comfortable working in complex environments
  • You are pragmatic and focus on delivering real-world value
  • You enjoy working across disciplines and bridging gaps within teams

What can we offer?

twoday is located in modern offices in 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will have a central role with exciting opportunities to develop in an international and innovative group, with exciting products and services within technology and software. You will also have the flexibility to "jump" and work from one of our headquarters in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, or Vilnius at times.

We're dedicated to build a workplace of diversity and inclusion. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience does not match the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

As our new (Senior) Data Scientist to the Accelerator team, you will work with vast amounts of untamed data, training deep learning models that push the boundaries of what is possible. As part of our team, you will play a crucial role in building and evaluating models, ensuring top-tier quality and generalization.




In close collaboration with our data and ML engineers you will have responsibilities in the building and maintenance of the data pipelines from data acquisition to producing predictions. This part of the job involves teamwork and understanding of the various interfaces from sensors to customer-facing UI to our own storage infrastructure. Furthermore, you will take ownership of data and AI modeling for specific, impactful projects.




We are a dynamic, fast-moving team dedicated to accelerating cutting-edge technology development. Our team brings together AI specialists, software developers, drone and robotics experts, and senior business developers turn emerging technologies into solutions for real operational needs. We are a diverse team in terms of nationalities, educational backgrounds and age, and our working language is English.




This is a team for people who like to make things happen. We value curiosity, initiative and strong bias for action. You will not just be behind a desk, you will be hands-on, whether it is climbing radar towers with a sensor in your backpack, spending days aboard a frigate gathering data, or launching newly designed drones in live military testing environments. We move quickly, learn by doing, and do whatever it takes to build technology that works in the real world.

Collaborate closely with data, ML and software engineers to integrate models into scalable and secure systems
Work with data streams, brokers and interfaces across sensors, storage infrastructure and customer-facing solutions

A collaborative approach to developing code and AI solutions
A fair understanding of statistics

Du samarbejder direkte med kunden, afklarer tekniske behov og skaber fremdrift i leverancen. Det afgørende er, at du både kan bygge løsningerne selv, sætte teknisk retning og løfte kvaliteten omkring dig.




Du bliver en del af et større fagligt miljø i vores AI, Apps & Automation-capability. Her arbejder du tæt sammen med data scientists samt software- og automationsspecialister og samarbejder på tværs af capabilities med data engineers, arkitekter, forretningskonsulenter m.fl.

Som Senior Data Scientist leder du det tekniske arbejde og er samtidig selv en aktiv del af udførelsen. Du arbejder hands-on med kode, modeller, eksperimenter, løsningsdesign og produktionsmodning.

Du tager ansvar for de svære tekniske valg og hjælper teamet med at fastholde kvalitet og fremdrift.




Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Lede tekniske AI- og machine learning-projekter fra problemforståelse til produktionsklar løsning
Omsætte uklare forretningsbehov til konkrete tekniske problemstillinger og løsningsdesign
Sætte teknisk retning og træffe valg om modeller, metoder, arkitektur og platforme
Drive tekniske afklaringer med relevante stakeholders hos kunden
Sikre sammenhæng mellem teknisk kvalitet, anvendelighed, governance og forretningsværdi
Bidrage til scoping, estimering og kvalificering af nye kundeopgaver
Mentorere kolleger og udvikle genanvendelige metoder, komponenter og accelerators

Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og videre specialisering

Title: Forward Deployed AI Scientist, Denmark - BCG X
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.

As a Data Scientist and Senior Data Scientist, you'll be part of our rapidly growing team. You'll have the chance to apply data science methods and analytics to real-world business situations across a variety of industries to drive significant business impact. You'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions.

Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X. Successful candidates are intellectually curious builders who are biased toward action, scrappy, and communicative.

We Are Looking For Talented Individuals With a Passion For Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research And Transforming Organizations Into AI Led Innovative Companies. Successful Candidates Possess The Following


Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
Significant experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills


What You'll Bring

Technologies

Programming Languages: Python

er flydende i Python og har erfaring med udvikling og implementering af AI-agenter
har erfaring med generativ AI, store sprogmodeller, RAG, information retrieval og evaluering af AI-agentbaserede løsninger
kan arbejde med versionering i git og formidle tekniske løsninger klart til både teknikere og ikke-teknikere

trives i teams og kan samarbejde med andre udviklere og forretningsanalytikere

You have experience in independently developing and delivering AI solutions, including LLMs that solve particular business challenges, including the process of preparing the setup for deployment and production.

As a Senior Data Scientist at 2021.AI, you will make your mark and directly influence the direction of data science in 2021.AI while delivering value with AI and ML to our partners and clients.

Run projects and implementation of AI for clients and partners
Share knowledge and develop best practices within Data Science
Educate client and teams about the usage of GRACE as Data Scientist
Embed those actions and insights into integrations and solutions for our clients' businesses
Ensure high project quality of our deliveries of AI solutions 
Bring business objectives to the center of the AI / ML development process

5+ years of hands-on, practical/industry project experience
Solid experience in Python programming, combined with practical software development experience including tests and automation

AI Engineering experience related to the implementation and deployment of AI into production via, e.g., FastAPI, Docker, Langchain, LiteLLM, OWUI etc.

Experience in practical project execution and delivery to demanding businesses
Fluent Danish, as several of our clients are public authorities. 
Fast learning and a proactive mindset
Outgoing personality with excellent presentation skills, both toward business leaders and technical experts
Exceptional human and collaboration skills

Founded in Copenhagen with several offices worldwide, 2021.AI is a fast-growing AI company focused on closing the gap between AI ambitions and real AI value for companies worldwide. Large private and public organizations globally trust us to help them stay competitive, compliant, and in control when applying AI. 




We are a team of passionate people who care deeply about the mission we are on; to positively impact the future with AI. We trust our team members and give them autonomy to do their best work. We also support professional development and provide regular feedback.
Meaningful Impact: In our company, every job matters, and you can see almost daily that you are making a meaningful impact. Our feedback loops are fast, which means you will have the opportunity to learn and advance quickly, growing together with the company. 
Outstanding Team: Our AI platform GRACE helps companies and people cooperate across the board, and we apply this mindset to our own team. We have a highly collaborative, no-bureaucracy culture. 
Excellent Benefits: We offer competitive pay, a healthcare benefits package, and a positive work-life balance.
For Copenhagen-based employees, we provide the corporate equipment you need, flexible working hours, team buildings, a fantastic office location in Nørrebro, Friday bars, coffee, laughs, and cutting-edge industry knowledge!

Title: Senior Data Scientist - System Optimization
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
The Impact You'll Make

Are you an experienced data scientist who wants to model how real energy networks physically behave — and then optimize across them?

Join Danfoss Digital Solutions, Utility, and help unlock the flexibility of district energy in the green transition.

The Vision We Are Building Towards
District heating and cooling utilities are facing their most demanding transition yet — changing production sources, electrified heat, volatile energy markets and a hard decarbonization mandate — operated, for the most part, with tools that optimize one asset or one hour at a time.

Our ambition is system-level optimization across production, network and demand, so that a utility can bring the best possible energy-economic value while honoring its decarbonization commitments.

What You’ll Be Doing
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to deepen the modelling and optimization core of our Utility team. You will apply mathematical modeling, programming skills and optimization theory to ensure our products deliver maximal value to our customers.

Some Of The Key Activities Will Include

Develop and extend our thermo-hydraulic simulation tools for district energy networks by applying physical modelling principles — flow, pressure and temperature dynamics across the network — augmented with machine learning and data driven methods.
Calibrate and validate the physical models against live network measurements, closing the loop between simulation, real operating data, and the hydraulic behavior of the networks we run.
Advance our production optimization solutions, where Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) and related techniques plan heat production and storage across grid-scale utilities.
Connect the layers into system-level optimization — production, network and demand treated as one problem, from heat producers through to consumers, including demand-side response.
Build and develop the data pipelines your models depend on, together with our data engineering platform team.
Own the problem and communicate with our customers – deeply understand the problem to solve, possible solution discovery, prototyping and validation. You can communicate technical solutions to non-technical collaboration partners.


The Team
Your main development team is based in Denmark, working with colleagues across several European locations. Beyond your daily team, you join a data science community in Denmark of experienced data scientists working on problems next to yours — production optimization, thermo-hydraulic network simulation, temperature optimization and forecasting. You will have people to think out loud with, review your models and challenge your assumptions, and you will do the same for them.

What We're Looking For
You are an experienced data scientist who knows how to solve complex problems by applying data modelling. You have experience working in a large development team in a modern software development environment. You own the problem and solution and at the same time collaborate with the team to make it happen.

On top of that, you should be able to check off as many of the following as possible:


Hold a Master’s degree or higher in a relevant quantitative field (mathematics, machine learning, statistics, physics, engineering, etc.)
PhD degree is a benefit, but not a strict requirement
Several years of experience applying data modelling to complex physical or industrial systems
Excellent command of Python as this is used as our main programming tool
Solid knowledge of district energy and thermo-hydraulic simulation — experience with physical modelling of flow, pressure and temperature in fluid networks is central to this role
Familiarity with numerical methods for simulating dynamic physical systems, and calibrating such models with measurement data
Experience in solving complex optimization problems, for example with Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), is an advantage
Experience with C# and C++ is appreciated, as these are used for some of our legacy solutions
Fluent in English
Willing to apply and learn about advanced methodology in the district energy field
Interested in blending physical models of heating and cooling systems with data-driven methods


Location
This position is based in our office in Copenhagen or Kolding, Denmark — Copenhagen preferred. We work closely as a team on site, and we are looking for someone who will be based in one of these two locations.

What You'll Get From Us
At Danfoss, we are engineering solutions that allow the world to use resources in smarter ways — driving the sustainable transformation of tomorrow.

Purpose-driven work. District energy is one of the most effective levers for decarbonising heat. The models you build shape how much fuel is burned, how much CO₂ is emitted, and how much value a utility can capture from flexible operation.

Depth, and the mandate to go deeper. Physics-based modelling of real networks is where our expertise sits and where we intend to stay ahead. This is not a feature factory — the hard modelling problem is the product.

Growth. We value continuous development and encourage it through courses, rotations and career tracks.

We believe that innovation and great results are driven by the right mix of people with diverse backgrounds, personalities, skills, and perspectives, reflecting the world in which we do business.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Title: Graduate Data Scientist (12 month FTC)
Description:
Department: Service Delivery

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Vodskov, DK

Description

Veovo is a market leader in Airport Smart Technology. With a global footprint of customers and capabilities that cover Airport Operations, Revenue management and Passenger Flow. Some of the world’s largest airports rely on Veovo. Focused on driving airport performance, our solutions enable airports to handle more aircraft and more passengers, with less delays and less queues. Our platforms are built on a modern tech stack, often delivered from the cloud as SaaS and leveraging intelligence to enable our customer to “go brilliantly”.

Our clients span continents, but all share one thing in common: they’re big names in airport excellence, with even bigger digital goals. With offices in the UK, Poland, Denmark, New Zealand and the US, Veovo offers a world of opportunity

At Veovo we strive to deliver predictable collaborative solutions that are the platform of great airports. At Veovo we strive to deliver predictable collaborative solutions that are the platform of great airports.

We focus on solutions in the analysis of queue and movement patterns as well as capacity forecasts. Our product, is cloud-based system that collects and analyzes data via proprietary (Bluetooth / WiFi) sensors, as well as third-party data sources such as camera, radar, infrared counters, coils, boarding cards, calendars, etc.

The solution primarily helps airports to forecast passenger appearance, optimize staff resources, reduce queue and travel times, and improve the experience for the passengers. In addition, we also create solutions for road traffic, railway stations, ports, ski resorts and amusement parks, with similar work and end-results.

Are you ready to be part of the team that brings our brilliant solutions "live" around the world?

The size of our installations are growing rapidly, and we are therefore seeking a skilled analytical person, who can help implement our solutions to help airports predict passenger arrival and flow. The implementation covers requirements, design, and calibration of the system. The calibration is carried out in-house via the setup of our filtering engine.

Your Key Responsibilities


Identify valuable data sources and automate collection processes
Undertake preprocessing of structured and unstructured data
Analyze large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns
Build predictive models and machine-learning algorithms
Combine models through ensemble modeling
Present information using data visualization techniques
Propose solutions and strategies to business challenges
Collaborate with engineering and product development teams


What We’re Looking For


Knowledge of R, SQL and Python; familiarity with Scala, Java or C++ is an asset
BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or relevant field
Analytical mind and business acumen
Experience in data mining
Problem-solving aptitude
Excellent communication and presentation skills


What We Can Offer You


Competitive salary
Private medical insurance
Pension contributions
Further education support
Flexible working arrangements
Rewards for length of service
A wide variety of learning and development programmes and opportunities


Interested?

If this role sounds like a good fit for you, please click on the “Apply” button to submit your application.

To discover more about Veovo and how we’re using technology to transform airport operations, please visit our website and LinkedIn.

The developer will co-build across the entire codebase with the current team to understand it and then take over ownership once the current team leaves. Must have

Python: solid and production-minded

Data science

Experiment tracking with MLflow

Collaborative programming and Git

Self-reliance, with the ability to unblock minor technical issues independently

Nice to have

Classical machine learning

Computer vision

Kubernetes

REST / FastAPI

Co-build across the entire codebase with the current team and prepare to take full ownership once they leave.

Own the project long term, maintain it, and continuously adapt it to changing business requirements.

Continuously evaluate model performance.

Solid, production-minded Python.

Comfortable taking over and maintaining an existing codebase.

Uses Git and works effectively in a collaborative development setup.

Title: Consultant for Data Science Consultancy Team
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Annalect, we help businesses across industries make better decisions — from marketing strategies to business development and sales forecasting. Our approach combines deep industry understanding with advanced, AI-powered analytical methods, enabling us to deliver insights and recommendations that make a real difference for our clients. In Denmark, we are more than 70 specialists based in Copenhagen and Aarhus. As part of Omnicom Media Group, we have over 300 colleagues in Denmark and a global network of more than 5,000 experts with whom we collaborate to create the best possible solutions for our clients.




Consultant for Data Science Consultancy Team

Are you passionate about applying Data Science in real-world scenarios? Do you want to leverage mathematics, statistics, and programming to help our clients make better decisions? Are you driven by data and analysis, and eager to translate insights into actionable recommendations? Join Annalect’s Data Science Consultancy team!




About the Role

We are looking for a new colleague to join Annalect, Omnicom Media Group’s specialist unit for data-driven analytics and decision support systems. Our work includes analyses that quantify the impact of our clients’ marketing activities and provide the foundation for ongoing optimization. Annalect consists of 60 employees, with 20 dedicated to the Data Science Consultancy team. Our team utilizes mathematics, statistics, and econometrics to process large volumes of data, delivering business-oriented decision support. As a Data Science Consultant, you will be involved in the entire project lifecycle for our clients – from data collection and coding, to building and optimizing statistical models in R, and communicating results and recommendations to clients. You will work closely with a project lead and the team, receiving ongoing support and feedback. As you gain experience, you will have the opportunity to conduct analyses independently, manage client communications, and deliver your own projects.




Key Responsibilities:

Collect client data and extract data from media systems
Programming and data processing
Structure, code, and interpret data
Develop statistical models in R
Analyze results and prepare recommendations in close collaboration with a project lead
Prepare deliverables for clients in PowerPoint and dashboards
Maintain ongoing dialogue with clients and media agencies throughout the project
Lead your own projects

Title: Machine Learning Researcher
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.




Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Machine Learning Researcher at Alipes.




At Alipes, we have been the market leader in automating the financial markets since we started back in 2008, shaping a fully automatic natural language processing system for reading and interpreting financial news.




To accomplish our mission of being the best at what we do, we understand the importance of elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels. Your work will involve leading the efforts in creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to seamlessly turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the financial markets.




In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.




You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.




About the team

All of this will happen in an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done. We are a tight-knit modeling team with fourteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities – eleven PhD’s and three MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We are working alongside two other teams of software developers and traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. What makes this constellation work great is that all of the individual team members write code and understand that a seemingly trivial change can actually require a lot of work, and vice versa.




About you

Fluency within mathematics and statistics.
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.
Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.
A scientific and inquisitive mind.




Nice to have

Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.




What we can offer you

Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.
A modern, harbour front office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.




Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and, in lieu of providing a cover letter, concisely answer the questions on the application. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.




Should you have questions about the role that you would like clarified before applying, you're welcome to send an email to quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please note that applications should not be sent to the email address but rather via the job link.

Title: Advanced Analytics Specialist, Supply Chain Intelligence
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about driving high-impact projects in a global supply chain? Do you want to play a key role in delivering transformational initiatives that shape how Ambu scales, operates, and delivers value to patients worldwide?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to shape how intelligence drives our supply chain.

We have recently evolved our analytics function into a Supply Chain Intelligence team within our Global Supply Chain organization, and we are seeking an Advanced Analytics Specialist to join us. The team’s ambition is clear: moving from describing what happened to knowing what to do next. You will play a central role in delivering this journey; building predictive and prescriptive models, enabling what-if scenarios and decision support, and strengthening the data foundation that underpins it all; while helping build a data-driven culture across the global supply chain.

At Ambu, we are on an ambitious growth journey - scaling our operations and capabilities to meet the rising global demand for our innovative medical solutions. As part of this journey, you will join a highly motivated team that values initiative, impact, and collaboration; and you will have a front-row seat in maturing how data and intelligence power our global supply chain.

The role

As an Advanced Analytics Specialist, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and deploy analytics solutions that move our global supply chain from descriptive dashboards to predictive and prescriptive intelligence. You will work across our five focus areas: data foundation, reporting & visibility, advanced analytics, decision support, and analytics enablement; with the greatest emphasis on advanced analytics and decision support.

This is a hands-on role where technical depth meets business-centric problem-solving. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Manager, GSC, you will partner with stakeholders across corporate functions and manufacturing sites – bridging business and IT – to ensure that data becomes a strategic asset embedded in how Ambu’s supply chain makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced analytics & decision support (primary focus)


Develop, deploy, and maintain predictive and prescriptive models (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization) that address concrete supply chain challenges across planning, operations, and distribution
Build what-if scenario and simulation capabilities that give leadership actionable decision support; not just reporting
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, and analytical results into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership
Automate recurring analyses and workflows to free capacity across the organization for higher-value work
Take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from problem framing and data preparation to model deployment in collaboration with back-end IT, monitoring, and adoption


Data foundation, visibility & analytics enablement


Contribute to advancing our data foundation toward a single source of truth; improving data quality, governance, and data models in collaboration with IT
Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and standard GSC reporting where they create genuine visibility and value
Support upskilling across the global supply chain through training, documentation, and self-service enablement; helping embed a data-driven culture
Stay curious about new technologies (AI, machine learning, modern analytics tooling) and proactively bring relevant opportunities into the team


Suggested candidate profile

Skills

Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have:


2–5 years of experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence roles. You may have gained your experience in a consultancy, an industrial company, or a data-driven scale-up
Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python (or R) for data preparation, analysis, and modelling
Solid experience with Power BI – including DAX and data modelling – and an eye for visualizations that drive decisions
Experience building predictive models (e.g., forecasting or machine learning) and bringing at least one into real operational use; you know the difference between a notebook and a solution people rely on
Strong business translation skills; you can turn a vague business question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result into a clear recommendation
A working understanding of supply chain processes (e.g., planning, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution); you don't need to be a supply chain expert, but you can speak the language of operations and understand the physical flows behind the data
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; you build trust quickly and collaborate effectively across functions and levels
A proactive, structured and independent way of working: you thrive in a maturing environment where you help build the way, not just follow it


It is an advantage if you have experience with the following:


Deeper experience within supply chain planning, S&OP, or distribution analytics
ERP data (e.g., Infor), cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Fabric), or optimization and simulation techniques
Experience in integrating new data (e.g., through API/EDI) into database and semantic models
Experience in training or upskilling non-technical colleagues
Exposure to a GxP-regulated industry


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process at the beginning of August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Quantitative Researcher - Power Markets
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Quantitative Researcher – Time Series & Signal Processing




Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Onsite)




Experience Level: Mid-Senior (2+ Years Professional or Applied PhD Research Experience)




Company: PowerXecution




About PowerXecution

PowerXecution is an algorithmic trading firm based in Copenhagen, backed by long-term institutional capital. We specialize in automated, data-driven trading strategies across European power markets. Operating with a flat organizational structure, our quants, developers, and experienced power traders work collaboratively to engineer scalable execution systems and low-latency quantitative models designed to operate at high capacity across continuous intraday and auction markets.




The Role

We are seeking an exceptional Quantitative Researcher with expertise in time-series modeling, signal extraction, and statistical inference. We welcome candidates from quantitative fields outside traditional finance such as signal processing, cryptology, physics, electrical engineering, or machine learning who possess deep expertise in extracting signal from noisy, non-stationary continuous data. Our trading desk provides direct domain onboarding on power market mechanics, allowing you to focus on developing high-performance predictive models.




Key Responsibilities

Signal Extraction & Alpha Generation: Research, develop, and backtest predictive mathematical signals targeting short-term continuous power and auction markets.
Non-Stationary Time-Series Modeling: Apply advanced statistical techniques or machine learning (e.g., gradient boosting, signal processing, domain adaptation) to resolve non-stationary distribution shifts in complex physical and financial data.
Multi-Dimensional Data Fusion: Extract actionable patterns from continuous order books, weather ensemble matrices, physical grid telemetry, and power ramp dynamics.
Research to Production Pipeline: Write clean, modular, production-grade Python code to transition statistical models from research environments into live execution engines alongside core software engineering teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work directly with experienced power traders who translate quantitative signals into live execution strategies, risk parameters, and PnL.




Qualifications & Experience

Education: Master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Applied Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or Cryptology/Signal Analysis).
Research & Technical Background: Minimum 2+ years of professional experience or applied PhD research handling high-noise, high-dimensional continuous time-series data.
Key Methodologies: Experience with domain alignment, distribution shifts, signal processing, game theory, or statistical inference from physical/noisy signals is highly valued.
Technical Skills: High proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost) with clean software engineering fundamentals and version control (Git).
Domain Knowledge: A strong interest in financial markets, trading, and continuous asset pricing is essential. While prior power, commodities, or algorithmic trading experience is a definite plus, it is not strictly required. We care most about your ability to build models and extract signals from complex, high-frequency data.




What We Offer

Domain Onboarding: Direct daily pairing with seasoned power traders who manage execution, market mechanics, and risk constraints.
Direct Commercial Impact: A meritocratic environment with zero corporate overhead, allowing research models to move into live deployment rapidly.
Modern Infrastructure: Access to a greenfield, high-performance computing and low-latency execution environment.
Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary accompanied by a performance-linked bonus structure directly reflecting individual and desk performance.

Title: Data Scientist til IDA - Ingeniørforeningen i Danmark
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
I IDAs afdeling Digital Udvikling, Arkitektur & BI søger vi en erfaren dataprofil, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem data science, data engineering og forretning.




Du får en central rolle i vores transformation fra en traditionel data- og rapporteringsplatform til en moderne dataplatform baseret på Databricks. Samtidig skal du være med til at omsætte data, teknologi og nye muligheder til løsninger, der skaber konkret og målbar værdi for IDAs medlemmer og forretning.




Du bliver en del af et velfungerende team på syv personer med et godt fagligt og socialt fællesskab, hvor samarbejde, nysgerrighed og interesse for at udforske nye teknologier går hånd i hånd.




En bred rolle på tværs af data science og data engineering

I BI & Data Science har vi en bred berøringsflade til resten af IDA, og du kommer derfor til at arbejde med mange forskellige fagområder og use cases. Det kan være alt fra personaliseret medlemsrådgivning til de mere end 3.000 arrangementer og kurser, der afholdes årligt.




Vi er et mindre team, og det betyder, at du får mulighed for at følge løsninger hele vejen fra den første idé og dialog med forretningen til udvikling, implementering og efterfølgende optimering.

Du kommer både til at arbejde med data engineering, data science og analyse, og vi leder derfor ikke efter en profil, der nødvendigvis ønsker at bruge hele dagen på udvikling af ML-modeller.




Det afgørende er, at du har en god dataforståelse, kan arbejde hands-on med teknologien og samtidig er nysgerrig på, hvordan data kan anvendes til at løse konkrete behov og skabe værdi.




Vær med til at bygge vores nye dataplatform

Vi er i gang med en vigtig udvikling af vores dataområde, hvor vi bevæger os fra en traditionel data- og rapporteringsplatform mod en moderne og mere sammenhængende dataplatform.

Databricks bliver fremadrettet vores samlede platform for BI og Data Science, og en central del af jobbet bliver at være med til at udvikle denne platform.




Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

migrering af eksisterende data, modeller og løsninger
udvikling og vedligeholdelse af ETL-flows og data pipelines
datamodellering og strukturering af data
optimering og videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger
udvikling af nye dataløsninger og use cases
data science, analyser og prædiktive modeller
videreudvikling af blandt andet churn-modeller, anbefalingssystemer og andre løsninger, der kan forbedre medlemsoplevelsen.




Vores tech stack omfatter blandt andet Python, SQL, Azure og Databricks samt AI-understøttede coding tools som Codex.




Python bliver et af dine primære arbejdsredskaber, og erfaring med Databricks vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er dog din grundlæggende forståelse for data, dataflows og moderne dataplatforme.




Teknologi skal skabe værdi

For os er teknologien ikke et mål i sig selv.

Udviklingen af vores dataplatform og løsninger er use case-drevet, og vi er optagede af, hvordan data konkret kan gøre IDA bedre til at forstå vores medlemmer, forudse deres behov og skabe bedre medlemsoplevelser.

Title: Commercial AI & Data Lead - Aurocon
Description:
Kan du omsætte data fra Aurocons intelligente IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder til konkrete produkter, bedre beslutningsgrundlag og nye kommercielle muligheder?




Fra IoT-data til produktudvikling og forretningsmuligheder




Aurocons voksende base af IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder genererer store mængder data om blandt andet hændelser, sensoraktivitet, connectivity, batteri, drift og installationer. Som ansvarlig for AI & Data bringer du disse data i spil.




Stillingen kombinerer strategi med hands-on udvikling, og særligt i starten er du selv den tekniske drivkraft. Du analyserer data, skriver kode, bygger prototyper og dokumenterer, hvor AI og machine learning kan skabe reel kunde- og forretningsværdi.




Dit ansvar omfatter blandt andet at:

kombinere IoT- og tidsseriedata med produktdata, historiske hændelser, supportviden og teknisk dokumentation
skabe struktur, kvalitet og en skalerbar arkitektur omkring virksomhedens datagrundlag
udvikle machine-learning-løsninger til analyse, anomalidetektion, klassifikation og prædiktion
definere og implementere Aurocons AI- og datastrategi
udvikle fundamentet for en modeluafhængig Aurocon AI Engine baseret på egne data og domæneviden
identificere nye AI- og dataprodukter, der øger værdien af Aurotrap-platformen og kan skabe recurring revenue
arbejde hands-on med LLM'er, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, function calling og AI-agenter
udvikle proof-of-concepts og bringe de rigtige løsninger fra prototype til produktion sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet




Du refererer direkte til CEO, arbejder tæt sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet og kommunikerer med både kunder og kommercielle samarbejdspartnere. CTO har ansvaret for hardware, embedded software, firmware og den tekniske produktplatform, mens du får ejerskab for data, analytics, machine learning og AI.




Teknisk builder med blik for produkt og forretning




Du er enten Head of AI i dag eller er klar til dit næste karriereskridt fra din nuværende position som AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Lead eller tilsvarende. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, evne til selv at bygge løsninger og din ambition om med tiden at tage et strategisk og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar.




Du har solid erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Data Science, Machine Learning og generativ AI
Python, SQL, data engineering og større datamængder
LLM-arkitektur, RAG, embeddings og vector databases
function calling og AI-agenter
API-integrationer, model deployment og MLOps/LLMOps
cloud-, data- og analyticsarkitektur.




Kendskab til f.eks. Qwen, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face eller vLLM er relevant. Du er ikke bundet til én teknologistak, men har en pragmatisk tilgang til teknologi og vurderer modeller og løsninger ud fra kvalitet, økonomi, latency, sikkerhed, GDPR, skalerbarhed og den konkrete forretningsværdi.




Derudover har du erfaring med IoT, tidsseriedata, hardware-enabled software og operationelle eventdata.




Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og selvkørende og trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd.




Din tekniske faglighed kombinerer du med et produkt- og forretningsorienteret mindset, der gør dig i stand til at prioritere muligheder ud fra kundeværdi, betalingsvillighed, differentiering, udviklingsomkostninger og skalerbarhed.




En spændende karrieremulighed




Du får en sjælden mulighed for at bygge et strategisk vigtigt område fra bunden. Aurocon har allerede de fysiske produkter, en international installeret base og et voksende datasæt fra enheder i virkelige miljøer. Ambitionen er, at data og AI bliver en central del af virksomhedens næste produktgeneration og langsigtede konkurrenceevne.




I takt med at området vokser, får du mulighed for at opbygge og lede et AI- og datateam. For den rette profil kan stillingen derfor blive et markant karriereskridt fra teknisk specialist til leder med et bredere strategisk teknologiansvar.




Om Aurocon




Auroconudvikler og producerer avancerede løsninger til skadedyrsbekæmpelse baseret på banebrydende teknologi.




Flagskibsproduktet The Aurotrap med tilhørende IT platform og mobil app, er en IoT baseret intelligent, giftfri multi-kill rottefælde, som gør det muligt at overvåge og håndtere rotteaktivitet i realtid.




Fra hovedsædet i Aalborg opererer Aurocon.io på internationale markeder og leverer løsninger, der forbedrer både operationel effektivitet og miljømæssig bæredygtighed.

Title: Trading Quant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 5317

Are you ready to be part of a team that drives transformation of the trading process - from client inflow to post-trade analysis? We are now looking for a curious Trading Quant that strives for data-driven decision-making, to enhance the measurability of the actions taken by traders and portfolio managers, and to enable our traders to better source liquidity and manage execution risk.

The role is a full time position based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Our Team

Meet the Trading Quants team. We add value by being change enablers that drive transformation of the investment process as part of an agile value stream where we identify business problems, define and implement solutions, to generate tangible value for our clients.

Our team is part of Nordea Asset Management, Global Trading. Within the investment management area, Global Trading, is responsible for order generation and trade execution on behalf of portfolio managers across asset classes. As a team, we homogenize data across asset classes, add structure and measurability to our investment processes, to unlock scale and quality throughout the organization.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Main responsibilities in this role:


Engage with traders to solve their execution challenges by providing them with data, frameworks, and tools that improve the search for liquidity and highlights execution risks.
Implement AI use cases leveraging our data models.
Drive projects within a value stream, binding together business and technology, to ensure we deliver tangible outcomes for our clients.
Ensure data-driven decision-making by expanding our Trading Data Model and its applications.
Interact with internal and external stakeholders, and our technology providers.
Extract data insights for client services and senior management on an ad-hoc basis.


You’ll join a motivated and experienced quant team that values a cooperative environment where you can draw on your teammates' expertise and commitment to excellence.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are someone who takes ownership of your work and is driven to make a meaningful impact, while being comfortable sharing your opinions and challenging established ways of thinking. You excel at both analytical and technical problem-solving skills, and have the ability to drive projects forward effectively within virtual team environments. You thrive on learning quickly, are interested in exploring alternative ways of working, and possess strong stakeholder management skills that enable you to build relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.

Your background and skills include:


A solid academic foundation e.g. a masters in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, etc.
Experience with Python and SQL.
An interest in asset management and financial markets.
Fluent in English both verbal and written.


It would be ideal if you also:


Are skilled in building data models using e.g. data build tool (dbt).
Have hands-on experience implementing AI use cases, or a demonstrable enthusiasm for leveraging AI to drive innovation and efficiency.
Have experience with SimCorp Dimension and Snowflake.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 11/09/2026.

For more information, you’re welcome to contact Simon Hørdum Bonde at simon.bonde@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Title: AI Innovation Specialist - Renewable Energy Solutions
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
At Vestas, we are looking for an AI Innovation Specialist who is curious, creative, and passionate about solving real-world challenges. You will collaborate across disciplines, explore emerging AI technologies, and develop solutions that improve how we design, operate, and service renewable energy technologies. Whether your background is in software, data science, robotics, or industrial digitalization, this is your chance to make a lasting impact.

Vestas Technology & Operations > Research & Development (R&D) > Balance of Plant and Service Innovation

At Vestas, the Balance of Plants (BoP) & Service Innovation Department transforms innovative ideas into real solutions that create value for customers and Vestas. We are exploring how AI can help solve real-world challenges across R&D, service and future renewable energy solutions.

We encourage curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning in a supportive environment where new ideas are welcomed, tested, and developed collaboratively.

Our team brings together a broad range of competencies, experiences, and perspectives. We believe the best ideas emerge when people challenge conventional thinking, learn from one another, and work together across disciplines. Whether your background is in software engineering, data science, robotics, industrial digitalization, or another relevant field, we would love to hear how you can contribute.

Responsibilities

As our AI Innovation Specialist, you will help bridge the gap between emerging AI technologies and practical business applications. You will work closely with domain experts, engineers, software developers, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, build solutions, and create measurable value.

You will:


Define, develop, and mature AI concepts from idea through validation and implementation
Identify opportunities where AI can drive meaningful improvements in service operations, enable scalability, automation, and future product concepts
Develop and validate AI solutions using image, video, audio, sensor, and operational data
Work hands-on with data, algorithms, and software development to create practical AI solutions
Collaborate with stakeholders across Service, R&D, and Product Management to translate business challenges into impactful AI solutions
Explore new advances in AI and Machine Learning and help shape future technology roadmaps
Contribute to innovation projects that create measurable business value and support Vestas' long-term strategic ambitions


Qualifications

We recognize that talent comes in many forms and that no candidate matches every requirement perfectly. If you are passionate about AI and innovation, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align with every qualification listed below.


You may hold a degree in:


Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Control Engineering, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline

Min. 04 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:


Experience developing and implementing AI or Machine Learning solutions in real-world environments
Good programming skills, particularly in Python
Experience working with modern AI and Machine Learning frameworks
Experience taking ideas from prototype to operational deployment
A practical, hands-on approach to problem solving and technology development
Experience with MLOps, cloud platforms, embedded AI, or edge computing technologies is considered an advantage but is not a requirement


Competencies


We are interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:


Computer Vision, Audio Analytics, Predictive Maintenance, Anomaly Detection, Industrial AI, Intelligent Automation, Data Analytics, VLM, LLM, Machine Learning

In addition, you:


Have a demonstrated ability to transform data into actionable insights and business value
Understand the end-to-end AI lifecycle from data acquisition and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
Can communicate complex technical concepts in a clear and engaging manner to both technical and non-technical audiences
A team player and enjoy collaborating across teams and disciplines
Are curious, proactive, and motivated by solving challenging problems
Thrive in an environment where innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning are part of everyday work


What We Offer

At Vestas, you will have the opportunity to shape how Artificial Intelligence is applied within a global leader in renewable energy. You will join a highly experienced and collaborative team that values curiosity, innovation, and knowledge sharing, while working on projects that deliver tangible business impact across service, engineering, and future technology development.

In this role, you will have significant influence on the direction of AI initiatives, the freedom to explore new ideas, and the support to turn them into practical solutions. We offer a flexible and trusting work

environment, opportunities for both professional and personal growth, and an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone is encouraged to contribute and succeed.

The primary work location for this position is Aarhus, Denmark.

We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 25th Sept 2026.

We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 50,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.

Growing as fast as we do in Veo means that every day is different, exciting, and challenging, both on the front line and in the back office.

But that’s not the most remarkable thing about us.

The coolest thing is our people. We’ve attracted some of the brightest minds in the industry. They are the reason we can create a great product and do it while enjoying ourselves.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 15 researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will be free to determine the directions of the project you work on while also getting feedback and being encouraged to spar with the rest of the team to assist each other in improving and succeeding.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking to add yet another ambitious, high-performing junior to senior engineer/researcher with proven experience from real-world machine learning projects to the team. Experience with computer vision is advantageous but not a must.

What you will do:



Train state-of-the-art machine learning models
Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge
Define and supervise data annotation tasks
Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings
Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks




What you will need:



MSc or PhD in a relevant field
Hands-on experience with real-world, large-scale machine-learning projects
Great coding skills
Skilled at both autonomous tasks and contributing to group efforts
Ability to examine details closely and critically




Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Title: Marketing Science Analyst
Description:
Are you experienced with data and analytics, and motivated by using them to make marketing and commercial decisions sharper for strong brands in Denmark and internationally?




We are looking for an experienced analyst to join the strategy unit within NoA Denmark. You will work alongside our lead Data Scientist and a team of experienced strategists on real client challenges for leading Danish and international brands.




What matters most is that you can put analytical methods to work in practice, and that you understand the commercial and marketing context they are applied in.




About NoA

The North Alliance (NoA) is one of the leading strategic and creative networks in the Nordics, with around 1200 people across the group. In Denmark, the NoA family includes &Co, NoA Ignite, Bold, NoA Health and NoA Connect.




We bring together strategy, creativity, design, technology and specialist expertise to help ambitious organisations create growth.




The strategy unit works across NoA, supporting its agencies and clients with strategic and analytical expertise. We focus on understanding how marketing creates value for the business, using data and analysis to help clients make better decisions.

The unit is newly established, giving you the opportunity to join early and help shape how we work.




What you will do

You will work closely with our lead Data Scientist and our strategists, running analyses within the frameworks and approaches he develops, and turning them into the data and insights our strategy consultants build recommendations on.




You will work hands-on with both third-party and client data from leading brands in Denmark and international markets. Your work may cover areas such as marketing performance, customer behaviour, campaign effectiveness and commercial outcomes.

Depending on the project, you might:




Build models and pipelines to gather and analyse web and other external data
Develop and test AI- and LLM-based tools for analysing marketing and advertising
Conduct statistical analyses and modelling, including correlations and regression
Contribute to marketing measurement frameworks, dashboards and reports
Explore new data sources, tools and techniques
Work with strategists and consultants to turn analysis into clear, actionable insights
Take part in client sessions and workshops, presenting findings in a way that lands with commercial and non-technical audiences




You will own your analyses end to end, with a strong senior team around you to spar with along the way.




What we are looking for

This role is suited to someone who already has experience from an agency, media or consultancy environment, or from an in-house marketing or commercial function. Exactly how many years matters less than what you have done with them. A background in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing or a related field is relevant, but what counts most is how you have applied it in practice.




We are looking for someone who:

Understands how marketing and media work commercially, and what actually drives value for a business
Works confidently and independently in Python or R, and is comfortable with SQL
Is strong at applying established analytical and statistical methods to messy, real-world client data
Can explain analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and hold their own in a room with senior stakeholders
Enjoys working with people from different disciplines
Is structured and reliable, and can take an analysis from brief to finished output without close supervision
Is comfortable working in English




Most importantly, you are someone who gets analyses done — pragmatic about method, precise about output, and focused on making the work genuinely useful to the client.




What we offer

Real ownership of analyses for leading brands from day one
Close collaboration with an experienced lead Data Scientist and a strong team of senior strategists
The opportunity to work on challenging projects for leading brands, Danish and international
Exposure to strategy, marketing, data science and AI in a real client environment
The chance to join a new unit early and help shape how we work
A collaborative culture with a flat hierarchy and room to develop
Great colleagues, high ambitions and plenty of fun along the way




Interested?

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.




Please send us your CV and a brief application, including a short introduction to yourself and why you are interested in joining the strategy unit at NoA.




We review applications as they come in, and the right fit decides the start date.

Title: Lead Data Analyst (Pricing & Monetization)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About The Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams.

What You’ll Be Doing


Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."


Who You Are


A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)


What’s In It For You


A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Are you driven, numerically sharp and eager to shape models, algorithms and decision-making at the center of a fast-moving energy trading firm? We’re looking for a Quantitative Analyst with strong analytical instincts and an interest in building production-ready solutions that push the boundaries between quantitative modelling and power trading. You should enjoy turning ideas into reality quickly, working with code, data and complex market dynamics to improve the tools that Nitor relies on every day.




As a Quantitative Analyst at Nitor Energy, you will help advance the models, algorithms and analytical frameworks that power our trading strategies. You will work directly with complex datasets, market dynamics and production-grade code to enhance the accuracy, speed and robustness of our decision-making tools. This role offers hands-on exposure to the full lifecycle of quantitative development in a modern energy-trading company, shaping ideas, testing assumptions and turning data-driven insights into real trading impact.




The Quantitative Analyst we’re looking for is motivated, analytical and want to help elevate our data, models and workflows while accelerating their own development. You should see yourself thriving in a team that executes quickly, turning ideas into production-ready solutions with a pragmatical mindset and sense of ownership.




Your tasks will include

Work closely with traders to develop and refine quantitative models that support profitable trading strategies
Continuously seek improvements to workflows, analytics, risk tools, and business processes
Conduct ad hoc quick analysis to support trading, risk, and commercial decision-making
Design, develop, and maintain analytic and operational views used for monitoring strategies and market dynamics for trading
Support the development and maintenance of Python-based models
Contribute directly to advancing and scaling our data infrastructure




What we expect

Hold a Master within a quantitative field
You have strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Have great python knowledge and an eagerness to code. Other code languages is a plus
You must be a strong team player
We expect you to have a pragmatic mindset and get things done
You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo
You have a do what it takes mentality and do not take no for an answer




What we offer

A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment
Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with experienced colleagues
The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on the team's development
A fun and social work environment with events such as Friday bars, poker tournaments, summer and Christmas parties etc. throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to boost team spirit, such as our Nitor-running club!
Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen
Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen




Expected start date: As soon as possible. Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position early if we find the right candidate.




About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.




Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.
