Title: Dataanalytiker til Efterretnings- og Analysecentret i National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du få forskellige datakilder til at tale sammen og finde mønstre og forbindelser i store, komplekse datamængder? Og vil du bruge dine kompetencer inden for dataanalyse og programmering til at styrke politiets indsats mod organiseret kriminalitet? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Din nye hverdag

Efterretnings- og Analysecenteret (EAC) er en del af National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet (NSK), som samler politiets og anklagemyndighedens specialiserede indsats mod organiseret, økonomisk og digital kriminalitet.

I Sektionen for analyse og projekter udarbejder vi analyser og efterretningsprodukter, som giver NSK bedre grundlag for at træffe taktiske, operative og strategiske beslutninger. Vi følger og kortlægger udviklingen i de kriminelle miljøer og undersøger nye kriminalitetstyper, fremgangsmåder og trusler.

Den viden omsætter vi til kriminalitets- og efterretningsanalyser, som giver ledelsen et oplyst og kvalificeret grundlag for at træffe beslutninger.

Som dataanalytiker har du en specialiseret rolle i den datamæssige del af analysearbejdet. Du samler og bearbejder data fra politiets egne systemer og eksterne datakilder og får forskellige formater og strukturer til at hænge sammen. Du omsætter rå data til et gennemarbejdet og dokumenteret datagrundlag, som sektionens øvrige analytikere kan bruge i deres analyser og vurderinger. Din opgave er dermed ikke primært at skrive de endelige analyseprodukter, men at finde de mønstre og forbindelser, som gør dem mulige og kvalificerer deres konklusioner.

Du Arbejder Blandt Andet Med At


udtrække, rense, strukturere og kvalitetssikre store og komplekse datasæt
koble data fra forskellige kilder og bearbejde data, der gør sammenhænge analyserbare og synlige
Udføre netværksanalyser (SNA) og andre kvantitative analyser, der synliggør relationer, mønstre og afvigelser
bruge eksempelvis Python eller R i dit arbejde med bearbejdning og analyse af store datasæt
udvikle og anvende metoder inden for ex. machine learning, der kan kvalificere eller effektivisere analysearbejdet
dokumentere datagrundlag, metoder og begrænsninger, så kollegerne kan anvende resultaterne sikkert.


Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med analytikere og andre fagligheder om at skabe det bedst mulige datagrundlag for vores analyser. Vi deler viden, udfordrer hinandens perspektiver og hjælper hinanden på tværs af sektionen. Omgangstonen er uformel, og vi lægger vægt på et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi vil være de bedste på vores område og lægger vægt på faglig udvikling og nye idéer. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dine egne kompetencer og bidrage til sektionens fortsatte udvikling. Vores arbejde er vigtigt og meningsfyldt, og vi ved af erfaring, at gode analyser kan få stor betydning for NSK’s arbejde.

Vores nye kollega

Vi søger dig, der har stærke dataanalytiske kompetencer og erfaring med at strukturere, koble og modellere data fra forskellige kilder. Du kan bruge programmering, eksempelvis Python eller R, til at behandle data og løse komplekse problemstillinger. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med machine learning, og det er en særlig fordel, hvis du også kan arbejde med social netværksanalyse, og skabe overblik over relationer mellem personer, grupper og hændelser.

Du har en relevant universitetsuddannelse, fx inden for social data Science eller et andet samfundsvidenskabeligt eller dataanalytisk område. Erfaring fra en lignende stillinger en fordel, herunder gerne i politiet eller andre efterretningsbaserede virksomheder og myndigheder. men det er ikke et krav.

Vi lægger derudover vægt på, at du:


Kan omsætte data, metoder og komplekse resultater til viden, som dine kolleger kan forstå og anvende
har en stærk talforståelse og kan visualisere data klart og forståeligt
arbejder analytisk, selvstændigt og struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs
tager initiativ og bringer din faglighed i spil i samarbejdet med andre
kan sætte dig ind i organisationens og analytikernes behov
Kan kommunikere sikkert på engelsk og dansk.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes på overenskomst for akademikere i staten. Der er til stillingen knyttet en fuldt arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Dit arbejdssted bliver National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet med adresse på Ejby Industrivej 125-135, 2600 Glostrup.

Din gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid er 37 timer inkl. betalt frokostpause. Vores normale åbningstid er mandag-onsdag kl. 8-16, torsdag kl. 8-15 og fredag kl. 8-14, men vi tilbyder flekstid og mulighed for i høj grad selv at tilrettelægge din arbejdstid. Efter en grundig introduktion til stillingen og dine kolleger, tilbyder vi muligheden for hjemmearbejde op til to dage om ugen

Politiet ønsker at understøtte og fremme medarbejdernes fysiske sundhed. Derfor har vi røg- og nikotinfri arbejdstid. Vi har en fælles kantine, der tilbyder morgenmad og frokostbuffet med salatbar og et bredt udvalg af sunde retter. Vi har en idrætsforening, vores eget fitnesscenter og en aktiv personaleforening.Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at du kan blive sikkerhedsgodkendt og kan opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele dit ansættelsesforhold.

Den forventede ansættelsesdato er 1. marts 2027 eller så snart du er blevet sikkerhedsgodkendt.

Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler 20. oktober 2026.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du har uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Malte Conrad på 2115-7646. Hvis du har spørgsmål til vores ansættelsesforhold, kan du kontakte rekrutteringskonsulent Anne Hansen på 2484-7798.

Du kan følge NSK på LinkedIn og finde information om politiet som arbejdsplads her.

Når du søger en stilling i politiet, opretter du samtidig en profil i vores rekrutteringssystem. Vi beder dig uploade ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis for din relevante grunduddannelse.

Ansøgningen skal være ganske kort og kun indeholde svar på følgende spørgsmål:


Hvorfor vil du gerne arbejde i NSK og for politiet
Hvilke dataanalytiske værktøjer tænker du er mest relevante i arbejdet for NSK og hvorfor?
Beskriv en analyse du er stolt af og hvorfor?


Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingen uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.

National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet som arbejdsplads

I National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet (NSK) bliver du en del af en landsdækkende specialenhed, hvor højt specialiserede fagfolk arbejder tæt sammen med et fælles formål: at beskytte Danmark mod den mest komplekse og samfundsskadelige kriminalitet. Det er en særlig opgave.

Vi efterforsker og strafforfølger komplekse sager inden for organiseret kriminalitet, økonomisk kriminalitet og digital kriminalitet. Derudover understøtter vi også politikredsene i hele Rigsfællesskabet med vores særlige ekspertise i kriminalteknik, it-efterforskning samt analyse- og efterretningsarbejde.

Når du træder ind ad døren i NSK, møder du politifolk, anklagere, analytikere, teknikere, it-specialister, administrative og mange andre fagligheder. Vi er mange – og vi er forskellige. Du får godt 1.200 dedikerede kolleger, der trods forskelligheder har det til fælles, at vi alle bidrager med hver vores særlige styrke og dybe faglighed.

Kriminaliteten udvikler sig hele tiden, og det samme gør kravene til os. Derfor prioriterer vi faglig udvikling, vidensdeling og samarbejde højt.

I NSK finder vi stor mening i vores arbejde, fordi vores opgaver har et klart og vigtigt formål. Det, vi gør, bidrager direkte til at beskytte samfundet og styrke retssikkerheden. Det er et særligt ansvar. Det er derfor, vi arbejder i NSK.

  • arbejder analytisk, selvstændigt og struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs
  • tager initiativ og bringer din faglighed i spil i samarbejdet med andre
  • kan sætte dig ind i organisationens og analytikernes behov
  • Kan kommunikere sikkert på engelsk og dansk.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes på overenskomst for akademikere i staten. Der er til stillingen knyttet en fuldt arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Dit arbejdssted bliver National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet med adresse på Ejby Industrivej 125-135, 2600 Glostrup.

Din gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid er 37 timer inkl. betalt frokostpause. Vores normale åbningstid er mandag-onsdag kl. 8-16, torsdag kl. 8-15 og fredag kl. 8-14, men vi tilbyder flekstid og mulighed for i høj grad selv at tilrettelægge din arbejdstid. Efter en grundig introduktion til stillingen og dine kolleger, tilbyder vi muligheden for hjemmearbejde op til to dage om ugen

Politiet ønsker at understøtte og fremme medarbejdernes fysiske sundhed. Derfor har vi røg- og nikotinfri arbejdstid. Vi har en fælles kantine, der tilbyder morgenmad og frokostbuffet med salatbar og et bredt udvalg af sunde retter. Vi har en idrætsforening, vores eget fitnesscenter og en aktiv personaleforening.Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at du kan blive sikkerhedsgodkendt og kan opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele dit ansættelsesforhold.

Den forventede ansættelsesdato er 1. marts 2027 eller så snart du er blevet sikkerhedsgodkendt.

Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler 20. oktober 2026.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du har uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Malte Conrad på 2115-7646. Hvis du har spørgsmål til vores ansættelsesforhold, kan du kontakte rekrutteringskonsulent Anne Hansen på 2484-7798.

Du kan følge NSK på LinkedIn og finde information om politiet som arbejdsplads her.

Når du søger en stilling i politiet, opretter du samtidig en profil i vores rekrutteringssystem. Vi beder dig uploade ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis for din relevante grunduddannelse.

Ansøgningen skal være ganske kort og kun indeholde svar på følgende spørgsmål:

  • Hvorfor vil du gerne arbejde i NSK og for politiet
  • Hvilke dataanalytiske værktøjer tænker du er mest relevante i arbejdet for NSK og hvorfor?
  • Beskriv en analyse du er stolt af og hvorfor?

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingen uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.

National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet som arbejdsplads

I National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet (NSK) bliver du en del af en landsdækkende specialenhed, hvor højt specialiserede fagfolk arbejder tæt sammen med et fælles formål: at beskytte Danmark mod den mest komplekse og samfundsskadelige kriminalitet. Det er en særlig opgave.

Vi efterforsker og strafforfølger komplekse sager inden for organiseret kriminalitet, økonomisk kriminalitet og digital kriminalitet. Derudover understøtter vi også politikredsene i hele Rigsfællesskabet med vores særlige ekspertise i kriminalteknik, it-efterforskning samt analyse- og efterretningsarbejde.

Når du træder ind ad døren i NSK, møder du politifolk, anklagere, analytikere, teknikere, it-specialister, administrative og mange andre fagligheder. Vi er mange – og vi er forskellige. Du får godt 1.200 dedikerede kolleger, der trods forskelligheder har det til fælles, at vi alle bidrager med hver vores særlige styrke og dybe faglighed.

Kriminaliteten udvikler sig hele tiden, og det samme gør kravene til os. Derfor prioriterer vi faglig udvikling, vidensdeling og samarbejde højt.

I NSK finder vi stor mening i vores arbejde, fordi vores opgaver har et klart og vigtigt formål. Det, vi gør, bidrager direkte til at beskytte samfundet og styrke retssikkerheden. Det er et særligt ansvar. Det er derfor, vi arbejder i NSK.

Title: Graduate - Data & Analytics | Autumn 2027

How will you contribute to shaping a better future—together?

Are you ready to kick-start your career in a collaborative and high-performing environment? Join our Data and Analytics team at EY-Parthenon and work alongside experienced colleagues on challenging and meaningful projects from day one.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Graduate in the Data & Analytics team, you will help our clients uncover the key drivers behind their businesses by combining analytics, technology, and commercial understanding. Working across mergers, acquisitions, and strategic initiatives, you will analyze large and complex datasets, develop innovative solutions, and apply advanced analytics and AI to answer critical business questions and support strategic decision-making.

As part of a Nordic-wide team with diverse backgrounds spanning data science, engineering, finance, and accounting, you will have the opportunity to work on projects across the Nordic countries, working side by side with talented colleagues who will support and guide you from day one.

To learn more about our various teams within EY-Parthenon, please visit our career site.

What We Look For


You have a dynamic, growth-focused mindset. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds who bring curiosity, collaboration, and a desire to grow. How you absorb information and take action matters as much as your education and experience. Varied perspectives make our team stronger.
You are curious and purpose driven. You see opportunities, ask insightful questions, and have a genuine interest in finance, M&A, technology and analytics — with a curiosity for emerging innovations and technology trends.
Graduating in 2027 or have recently completed a relevant master’s degree. We welcome applications from a variety of academic backgrounds. Relevant fields may include Economics, Finance, Data Science and Engineering.
Qualifications:
An analytical mindset and a genuine enjoyment of tackling complex problems.



Ability to collaborate effectively in teams with people from varying technical and personal backgrounds.



Strong communication and presentation skills.



Experience/knowledge of programming language, data modelling, visualization and AI/ML using tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Fabric, and LLMs such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Claude.

What’s In It For You


Attractive compensation package with comprehensive insurance package, pension and employee benefits.
An exciting introductory program, connecting you with fellow graduates across the Nordics.
Personalized support and mentorship through a dedicated buddy and counselor invested in your success.
Flexible and hybrid-working conditions.
Continuous learning and development opportunities, empowering you to shape and grow your career through hands-on experiences and new challenges.


What You Can Expect

If this opportunity sounds like a fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Application deadline: 11 October 2026.

The Steps In Our Recruitment Process Are As Follows


Application: Upload your CV and latest grade transcript.
Assessment: After we receive your application, you’ll get an assessment link within a few days. It takes about 20 minutes to finish.
Video: After completing the assessment, you'll be asked to submit a short video about your motivation for this role.
Interview: Selected candidates will be invited to two rounds of face-to-face interviews, including one case interview. The interviews will take place in November and December 2026.


Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive recruitment experience, please let us know if you require any accommodation during the recruitment process.

Get to know us and follow us on Instagram (@ey_denmark).

Title: Forsker søges til Afdeling For Depression og Angst, AUH
Description:
Forsker søges til Afdeling For Depression og Angst, AUH,

Forskningsenheden under Afdeling for Depression og Angst (ADA) ved Aarhus Universitetshospital søger kandidater til en tidsbegrænset stilling (18 måneder) pr. 01. december 2026 som forsker med fokus på udvikling af maskinlæringsalgoritmer til forudsigelse af kliniske outcomes hos patienter med psykisk sygdom.

Om forskningsenheden

ADA er en del af Aarhus Universitetshospital. Vii tilbyder udredning og behandling af høj faglig kvalitet til voksne patienter med lidelser inden for det affektive spektrum. Afdelingens forskningsenhed består af en professor samt ca. 20 fuldtids- og deltidsforskere. Forskningsenheden har stor faglig diversitet og rummer bl.a. læger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, programmører og en statistiker.

Arbejdsopgaver

Arbejdsopgaverne vil bl.a. omfatte


selvstændig forskning med fokus på udvikling og validering af maskinlæringsalgoritmer
publikation af forskningsresultater
sparring med øvrige forskere i Forskningsenheden
bidrag til fondsansøgninger
deltagelse ved seminarer og konferencer
vejledning af yngre forskere og studerende.


Vi tilbyder


en stilling i et stærkt tværfagligt forskningsmiljø
tæt samarbejde med kliniske miljøer
mulighed for nationale og internationale samarbejder.


Ønskede faglige kvalifikationer


erfaring med forskning i maskinlæring med anvendelse af sundhedsdata (ideelt journaldata)
formel forskningsuddannelse
erfaring med publikation af forskningsdata i tidsskrifter med peer review
stærke samarbejdskompetencer og erfaring med tværgående samarbejde
forstår, taler og kan skrive dansk og engelsk (datamaterialet består bl.a. af journaltekst på dansk).


Ansættelsesforhold

Der er tale om en tidsbegrænset fuldtidsstilling (18 måneder) med opstart d. 1. december 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børne- og straffeattest.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Professor Søren Dinesen Østergaard på tlf. 6128 2753 eller på mail soeoes@rm.dk.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 22. september 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt d. 24. september 2026.

ENGELSK VERSION

Researcher

The research unit of the Department of Affective Disorders at Aarhus University Hospital is seeking candidates for a fixed-term position (18 months) as researcher with a focus on developing machine learning algorithms to predict clinical outcomes in patients with mental illness.

About The Research Unit

The Department of Affective Disorders is part of Aarhus University Hospital. We offer high-quality assessment and treatment for adult patients with affective disorders. The department's research unit consists of a professor and approximately 20 full-time and part-time researchers. The research unit has substantial professional diversity and includes, among others, doctors, psychologists, nurses, programmers and a statistician.

Tasks


independent research with a focus on the development and validation of machine learning algorithms
publication of research results
sparring with other researchers in the research unit
contribution to grant applications
participation in seminars and conferences
supervision of younger researchers and students.


We offer


a strong interdisciplinary research environment
close collaboration with clinical colleagues
opportunity for national and international collaborations.


Desired Professional Qualifications


experience with research in machine learning using health data (ideally medical record data)
formal research training
experience with publication of research data in peer-reviewed journals
strong collaboration skills and experience with interdisciplinary collaboration
understands, speaks and can write Danish and English (A main data source is medical record text in Danish).


Employment conditions

This is a full-time, fixed-term position (18 months) starting on December 1st, 2026.

Salary and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective agreement. The employment is conditioned by a satifying child criminal record.

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Søren Dinesen Østergaard at +45 6128 2753 or by mail soeoes@rm.dk.

Application deadline is September 22nd 2026 and the interviews are expected to be held on September 24th, 2026.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

Job Description

We are excited to offer an opportunity for a curious, commercially minded Data Expert to help shape the future of marketing analytics at the LEGO Group. Based in our Copenhagen or Billund office, this role sits within the Global Paid Media Performance Analytics team and plays a key role in building the data foundations, analytical models, and scalable pipelines that enable better business decisions across our global marketing organisation.

Reporting to the Global Head of Paid Media Performance Analytics, you do not need a paid media background. Instead, we're looking for someone with strong data and analytics expertise who enjoys solving complex data challenges, building robust data pipelines, and translating data into meaningful business insights.

Come and join one of the most loved brands in the world in a brand-new department where you can have maximum impact. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Please apply with an English CV

No relocation support offered


Core Responsibilities

Build scalable data solutions – Design, develop and maintain robust data pipelines, analytical datasets and scalable data products that support global marketing measurement and business decision-making.

Develop advanced analytics – Apply statistical methods, analytical techniques and experimentation to uncover insights and improve how marketing performance is measured.

Create trusted data foundations – Partner with engineering and digital enablement teams to ensure high-quality, reliable and well-governed data that supports analytics across the organisation.

Bridge data and business – Translate complex datasets into actionable insights and collaborate with business stakeholders to define analytical requirements and solve commercial challenges.

Enable better decision-making – Develop reusable analytical frameworks, automation and reporting capabilities that improve efficiency and help teams make data-driven decisions.

Collaborate across functions – Work closely with analytics, technology, reporting and marketing teams to continuously improve data capabilities and deliver impactful solutions.

Play your part in our team succeeding!

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building modern data solutions and solving complex analytical problems. You'll help establish the data infrastructure and analytical capabilities that enable better marketing measurement and commercial decision-making across the LEGO Group.

As part of the Global Paid Media Performance Analytics team, you'll bring strong technical expertise, a collaborative mindset and a passion for turning data into business value. While the team supports marketing performance, your focus will be on building the data capabilities that make advanced analytics possible.

Do you have what it takes?



Experience as a Data Expert, Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer or in a similar analytical role.
Strong experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and transforming complex datasets into reliable analytical products.
Advanced programming skills in Python and SQL.
Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Spark, Git, and cloud-based data environments.
Experience developing analytical models, automation and data workflows that improve business decision-making.
Strong understanding of data modelling, data quality and data governance principles.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A curious, problem-solving mindset with a passion for using data to create business impact.
Experience working with marketing or digital data is beneficial but not required.
English language proficiency, both written and spoken.
Ability to work three days per week from our Copenhagen or Billund office (with two days working from home).

Title: PhD scholarship in Foundation Models for Clinical Bioinformatics and Cancer Prevention - DTU Health Tech
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you interested in becoming a bioinformatics researcher working to improve the treatment and prognoses of colorectal cancer patients?

Then this is the position for you. You will join the ongoing efforts of researchers at the Department of Health Technology at the Technical University of Denmark and the Center for Surgical Science (CSS) at the University Hospital Zealand in Køge. The overall aim of this project is to integrate phenotypic data from national population-wide registries with multi omics data generated to characterize colorectal cancer samples and ultimately predict postoperative recurrence of the disease.

Responsibilities And Qualifications

You will work at the interface of artificial intelligence, bioinformatics, and clinical research. The project aims to develop novel computational models that integrate nationwide longitudinal health data with microbiome and genomic data to better understand adenoma-to-carcinoma progression and support clinically relevant decision-making. The candidate will contribute to the development of foundation models for sequence data and patient trajectories, representation learning approaches for microbial genomes and microbiomes, and predictive models linking molecular and clinical data to cancer risk stratification.

The work will be carried out in close collaboration with computational researchers at DTU and clinical experts at the Center for Surgical Science. The project offers a unique opportunity to work with nationwide Danish health registries, large-scale microbiome datasets, and state-of-the-art machine learning methods.

You are expected to:


Develop and apply machine learning and foundation-model approaches for large-scale longitudinal health data and large-scale genomic data.
Integrate clinical, microbiome, and genomic data to uncover factors associated with adenoma progression and colorectal cancer development.
Develop computational representations of patient trajectories and microbial communities using modern AI and bioinformatics methodologies.


The following qualifications are required:


A master's degree in bioinformatics, computer science, computational biology, data science, biomedical engineering, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience with statistical analysis and machine learning.
Experience handling and analyzing large-scale biological or health-related datasets.


You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment

The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education .

We offer

DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms

The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures .

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is 1 December 2026 or after mutual agreement.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here .

Further information

Further information may be obtained from Ole Lund, olund@dtu.dk .

You can read more about DTU Health at www.healthtech.dtu.dk/english and www.healthtech.dtu.dk/english/research/research-sections/section-bioinformatics .

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark . Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “ PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar ” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU.

Application procedure

Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 18 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:


A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
Curriculum vitae
Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale


You may apply prior to ob­tai­ning your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829

DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Title: Postdoc in Computer Vision for AI-based Segmentation and Quantification 3D micro-CT data for Natural Heritage - DTU Compute
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you excited about scientific AI and developing efficient computer vision methods for analysis of complex 3D scans of natural heritage samples? Join our interdisciplinary team as a postdoc to develop advanced segmentation and other analysis methods for a novel robotic micro-CT system that will transform how natural history collections are digitized and studied. You will have the opportunity to conduct high-impact research in computer vision for 3D volumetric images, contribute to widely used open-source software, collaborate with leading researchers in physics and natural history, and publish your work while helping build technology with lasting scientific impact.

Responsibilities And Qualifications

We are looking for a highly motivated early-career researcher in advanced image segmentation methods to join our imaging research group and project “Natural Heritage 3D”. This collaborative project between Visual Computing @ DTU Compute, DTU Physics, Copenhagen University, and the Natural History Museum aims to develop a fully automated robotic computed tomography system along with computational methods to enable 3D digitization of large collections of natural history specimens.

The Natural History Museum has millions of natural specimens collected over 400 years, which provide an enormous source of information on natural history. CT scans provide a unique method to visualize internal features in 3D in a fully non-destructive manner. In an effort towards digitizing collections and unlocking hidden information on an unprecedented scale, an automated CT system is being developed to scan and analyse large quantities of such specimens. Selected science cases include seal and polar bear craniums as well as snakes and lizards preserved in alcohol.

In addition to experimental CT scan equipment, a key component is the computational pipeline to turn acquired CT projections through reconstruction and image analysis into digital volumes and extract relevant quantitative data. Given the large quantities of specimens, scanning needs to be fast and automated, which demands state-of-the-art reconstruction and analysis methods to handle the data arising from very fast scans taken with few and noisy projections. The focus of this postdoc position is the segmentation and quantification steps, conducting research, and developing suitable analysis methods to produce measurements of the structures in the 3D volumetric images of natural heritage specimens. Our robotic micro-CT system at the DTU 3D Imaging Center enables scanning of thousands of samples, so we will focus on scalability and statistics at a scale beyond current state-of-the-art.

Your primary activities include:


Develop new segmentation methods for large-scale analysis of micro-CT data.
Develop and validate methods for efficient human-in-the-loop segmentation of CT images.
Explore the use of self-supervised foundation models for segmentation with limited labels.
Establish reference benchmark datasets for natural heritage.
Collaborate with domain experts in natural heritage and evolutionary biology.
Contribute to and be part of open-source scientific software communities around the Core Imaging Library and qim3D packages.
Publish scientific articles within computer vision, data, and applications in collaboration with colleagues in physics and natural history.


This role is part of the QIM Center for Quantification of Imaging Data (https://qim.dk/). As part of QIM, you will be interacting with a large imaging network in connection with large-scale facilities such as MAX IV, ESS, DTU 3D Imaging Center, and other facilities internationally. Title: Principal Biostatistician
Place: Hørsholm Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Do you bring advanced statistical expertise and insights to shape how evidence is built, not merely to analyse data? If so, this Biometrics role at ALK could be your next career challenge.




ALK develops allergy immunotherapy treatments that modify the immune system's response to allergens rather than just treating symptoms. Our clinical trials generate the evidence that gets those treatments to patients in North America, Europe, and China, and that supports the new products and indications we are building next.




This is not a role in taking a statistical analysis plan and executing it. It is about being the person others come to when a question is still open: an authority comes back with a question that needs more than a standard answer, a submission in a new market needs a route mapped out, a development opportunity is still a rough idea. That kind of work is growing here, which is why the role exists. You demonstrate deep statistical proficiency, a keen sense for which methods are fit for purpose, and the confidence to advocate for better solutions.




A forward-looking mindset is essential in this role. Artificial intelligence is reshaping statistical practice and will continue to do so. What will not change is the need for accountable scientific leadership: clearly articulating assumptions, making principled design decisions, interpreting results with rigour, and standing behind the conclusions we endorse. We seek a colleague who advances the department and drives continuous improvement, rather than simply maintaining the status quo.




You will be part of Biometrics, a department consisting of Biostatistics, Clinical Data Management, and Statistical Programming. We support the full product lifecycle, from early development through marketing authorisation and variations to publications and post-market support. We combine the agility of a small team, where individual insight can rapidly shape direction, with the breadth to provide visibility across the entire development arc.




What you will be doing

Shape regulatory strategy, and the statistical thinking behind how we build and defend the evidence.
Take the lead when authorities come back with questions, working out the statistical response and the argument behind it.
Scope new development opportunities. Turn a rough idea into a project and trial outline: what is needed, what is feasible, and how to sequence it.
Run scenario work across projects, so decisions get made with a clear view of what each option would mean.
Explore what our concluded studies can still support, and where there is more to get from data we already have.
Be a sparring partner across the organisation. Listen to what colleagues are trying to achieve, translate it into statistical terms, and propose a way forward.
Contribute statistical input across the line: trial designs, protocols, briefing books, summary documents, publication review, and due diligence.
Represent statistics with regulatory authorities, partners, and key opinion leaders, and explain statistical issues clearly to people who are not statisticians.
Expand the department's methodological range. Bring in approaches we are not using yet, and make the case for when they add value.




What we are looking for

A candidate with a comprehensive statistical toolkit coupled with the judgment to select the appropriate method for each problem. You are as comfortable proposing an approach as executing one.
Someone with a holistic view, comfortable when a question is still taking shape. You see how a design choice early on shapes what can be claimed later.
A suitable candidate will have a good awareness of new trends in statistics and a profound knowledge of statistical regulatory guidelines within the pharmaceutical industry and the ability to support other biostatisticians to utilise new statistical methods.
The confidence to challenge constructively, identifying when a plan will not meet stakeholder needs and proposing more effective alternatives; values rigorous discussion as much as the final decision.
Curiosity about where the field is going, and a view on which new methods and tools are worth adopting. You bring colleagues along with you.
Good knowledge of SAS programming. Familiarity with R or Python is an advantage.
Strong communication skills. You can explain a statistical issue to a clinician, a regulator, and a project team, and be understood by all three.
The ability to work independently, hold several priorities to timelines, and work across functions.




You have a solid theoretical background in mathematical statistics, at minimum MSc level or equivalent, and at least 10 years of experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical industry. You know the statistical regulatory guidelines well. Insight into pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics is an advantage. Experience in allergy, immunology, or respiratory is a plus, but the ability to get up to speed in a therapeutic area matters more than already being there.




Become a part of ALK

ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specialised in allergy immunotherapy. We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues.




Our offices in Denmark offer a green view of the DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We believe that physical presence enforces strong teamwork and collaboration and creates success, so it is important that you enjoy coming to work at our site with a degree of flexibility to also work from home.




Apply

Please apply by attaching a short letter of motivation and your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants. Deadline for applying is on the 22 September 2026. Do you want to learn more about our company, we encourage you to visit us at www.alk.net.

Title: Scientist, Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology (PK/PD Modeling & Simulation)
Description:
Join Hemab, a clinical-stage biotech company, on an exciting journey to build the ultimate clotting company. We focus on addressing the high unmet needs of patients suffering from rare bleeding and thrombotic disorders. With offices in Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark, Hemab cultivates a vibrant, agile and forward-thinking environment where collaboration, innovation, and high-quality biotherapeutics development go hand in hand.

As a Scientist, PK/PD Modeling & Simulation, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and applying population PK, PK/PD, exposure–response and QSP models to support model-informed drug development across Hemab’s pipeline. You will work closely with internal cross-functional leads (clinical pharmacology, nonclinical, clinical development, biometrics, regulatory and quality) and external collaborators (CROs and consultants) to provide quantitative insights that inform dose selection, clinical study design, and regulatory filings. Your work will be central to integrating modeling and simulation strategies into Hemab’s clinical programs and advancing our mission to deliver first-in-class therapies to patients with rare bleeding disorders.

At Hemab, we foster an environment where everyone can wear multiple hats depending on their experience, fit, and motivation to get things done. We constantly strive to celebrate our achievements collectively and gather feedback to continuously sustain and improve our fast-paced, cross-functional work environment.




What you'll do at Hemab?

Develop, validate, and execute population PK, PK/PD exposure–response, PBPK and QSP models to support dose selection, regimen optimization, and trial design.
Perform simulations to inform early clinical study design, establish clinical proof-of-concept (PoC), and guide pivotal program decisions.
Analyze preclinical and clinical PK/PD data, translating insights into actionable recommendations for clinical teams.
Contribute quantitative components for regulatory submissions (INDs, CTAs, BLAs) and respond to agency questions on modeling and simulation deliverables.
Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure modeling insights are integrated into development plans and communicated clearly to stakeholders.
Stay current with regulatory expectations, industry trends, and new quantitative methods to continuously improve modeling strategies and workflows.
Support vendor and consultant selection and management to ensure high-quality, timely deliverables for modeling and simulation activities.
Be a proactive and collaborative team player, receptive to constructive feedback and committed to meeting program goals.




Who You Are and What You'll Bring to Hemab?

Education: Ph.D. in Pharmacometrics, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacokinetics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or related field; with 1–3 years of relevant experience.
Experience: Hands-on experience with population PK/PD modeling software (NONMEM, Monolix, Phoenix NLME) and programming languages (R, MATLAB). Strong understanding of PK/PD principles, biologics drug development, and model-informed drug development strategies.
Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: biologics PK/PD, rare disease development, translational modeling, or target-mediated drug disposition (TMDD). Familiarity with quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) approaches is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, interpret, and communicate complex quantitative data to diverse audiences, including cross-functional teams and regulatory authorities.
Experience contributing to or supporting regulatory submissions is desirable.
Excellent problem-solving skills, scientific curiosity, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced biotech environment.

Title: AI / Data Engineer - Route Intelligence
Description:
Waste collection is a routing and forecasting problem at city scale. WasteHero's platform already plans routes and fleet for municipalities and haulers in six countries; we are now building the AI layer on top: fill-level forecasting, dynamic routing, anomaly detection and an AI assistant for operations teams.




What you will do

- Design and ship models and data pipelines that turn collection, container and vehicle data into better routes and fewer missed pickups.

- Build the evaluation and monitoring around them so customers can trust the numbers.

- Work with our engineers to put LLM-based assistants into daily operations workflows, with guardrails.

- Partner with implementation teams on real municipal data, warts and all.




What we look for

- 3+ years in applied ML or data engineering with production deployments.

- Strong Python; comfortable with SQL, dbt/Spark-style pipelines and cloud ML tooling.

- Experience with optimisation (VRP, scheduling) or time-series forecasting is a strong plus.

- Pragmatic: you pick the simplest model that moves the operational metric.




Why WasteHero

A rare dataset (millions of collections across countries), a clear KPI (kilometres, missed pickups, complaints) and customers who deploy what you build. Remote-friendly across Europe; Aarhus is home base.




WasteHero is an equal opportunity employer. Apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV; no cover letter needed. We reply to every applicant within two weeks.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer (Agentic AI)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Our Purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a Machine Learning Engineer for Agentic AI & ML, you will work at the intersection of research and production. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and customers to translate ambiguous challenges into effective, shipped features. You will work on features throughout the lifecycle - from discovery and model building to production deployment and maintenance. By designing and shipping ML and agentic systems, you will expand the platform's capabilities to fundamentally reshape how business owners run their operations and how workers manage transparency and work-life balance.

What You’ll Do


Build and optimize ML models to enhance and extend Planday, framing problems from real metrics and engineering robust feature pipelines.
Design and ship agentic systems involving tool use, function calling, and multi-agent orchestration for reliable planning workflows.
Deploy and operate model services in production, ensuring performance for cost and latency through caching, batching, and quantization.
Design and run rigorous evaluations, including LLM-as-judge and regression suites, so quality changes are always measured.
Collaborate on turning research prototypes into reliable, observable production workflows and pipelines.


Success looks like


Stable and sustainable support for live ML services in production as our variety of deployments grows.
Successful release of new features like auto-scheduler models and intelligent AI agent needs.
Reduced ambiguity in model quality through the implementation of repeatable and high-fidelity evaluation sets.
Proactive maintenance and debugging of production services, ensuring high reliability for end-users.
Delivery of research-backed features that directly improve complex workflows like shift assignment.


What You’ll Bring With You


3–5 years of hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning or data systems in production environments.
Strong collaborative skills - we are a small, high-impact team, and we view cross-functional partnership as a feature, not a bug.
Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (metrics, validation, leakage) and a strong theoretical foundation in AI research.
Practical experience shipping ML or data systems in production environments, beyond purely academic or notebook settings.
Strong Python skills, including experience with numerical and dataframe libraries such as NumPy and pandas.
Experience writing tested, maintainable, and observable code for services deployed to the cloud.
Hands-on experience with LLM applications and agentic architectures, such as RAG, function calling, or planning workflows.
Familiarity with data tooling (SQL, dbt, Snowflake/Databricks) and an end-to-end mindset for product building.
MSc or equivalent experience in a quantitative field. You combine a strong theoretical foundation with a pragmatic approach, are adept at translating business needs into technical solutions, and actively stay informed on relevant frontier developments.


At Planday, we offer you


Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us
Flexible remote work
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities


Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

Title: Safety Scientist- Real World Evidence (RWE), EMEA
Description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Join Us as a Safety Scientist III – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our expert team, you’ll have the opportunity to ensure operational excellence that makes a real difference in patient safety. As a Safety Scientist III, you will be responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of signal detection and product safety scientist activities, with a focus on tasks that are low to high in complexity or which concern low to high complexity products. Additionally, you will support the mentoring of more junior colleagues, the development of processes, tools, and systems, and may serve as lead on smaller FSP-type projects.

Roles And Responsibilities


Support strategies for safety data generation, assessment, and communications by regular interactions with Safety Evidence Leads and other stakeholders across the organization world-wide, to gather information on topics to be analysed and present findings at internal meetings.
Synthesize contributions from multiple sources of data into meaningful insights in order to demonstrate product(s) value.
Monitor competitive environment for new safety information, and compares to safety information of our product(s), thus supporting differentiation activities.
In collaboration with Safety Evidence Leads and other stakeholders such as Biostatistics and Digital Technology, establish safety evidence information platforms/dashboards and oversees regular updates. Identify areas for innovation including AI/machine learning and similar.
Conduct data mining activities on regular basis to identify data gaps, and communicate safety findings promptly.
Ensure reproducibility and traceability of analyses through structured workflows and version control.
Maintain documentation of data extraction and analyses.
Assist in the design, execution, and reporting of pharmacoepidemiologic studies to address specific safety questions.
Attends relevant internal and external meetings for training, competitor intelligence, and collaboration with KOLs and other experts.


Skills And Competencies


5+ years of experience in data analysis to understand complex linkages of safety data from various sources, preferably in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare setting. Experience working with safety databases required, experience with large healthcare datasets (e.g., EHR, claims, registry data) is a plus
Proficiency in data extraction from the safety database (e.g. Argus Safety) and generating data insights using adequate digital tools.
Ability to identify gaps and translate them into actionable plans, especially cross-functionally, through technological tools (e.g. GenAI, Copilot, automation tools, etc.) without compromising clinical integrity.


Education, Experience And Qualifications


Degree in Data Science, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Public Health, Computer Science, or a related field.
Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI, safety signal tools such as E
Empirica, or cloud-based data platforms. Proficiency in statistical programming languages (e.g., R, SAS, Python) is a plus.
Minimum of 5 years working in pharmaceutical/biotech industry.
Experience in regulated environments (both GCP and GVP).
Experience in RWE generation, pharmacoepidemiology and/or rare disease is a plus.
Ability to travel up to 20% of time as needed.


Why Join Us?

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

Title: Data Scientist til IDA - Ingeniørforeningen i Danmark
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
I IDAs afdeling Digital Udvikling, Arkitektur & BI søger vi en erfaren dataprofil, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem data science, data engineering og forretning.




Du får en central rolle i vores transformation fra en traditionel data- og rapporteringsplatform til en moderne dataplatform baseret på Databricks. Samtidig skal du være med til at omsætte data, teknologi og nye muligheder til løsninger, der skaber konkret og målbar værdi for IDAs medlemmer og forretning.




Du bliver en del af et velfungerende team på syv personer med et godt fagligt og socialt fællesskab, hvor samarbejde, nysgerrighed og interesse for at udforske nye teknologier går hånd i hånd.




En bred rolle på tværs af data science og data engineering

I BI & Data Science har vi en bred berøringsflade til resten af IDA, og du kommer derfor til at arbejde med mange forskellige fagområder og use cases. Det kan være alt fra personaliseret medlemsrådgivning til de mere end 3.000 arrangementer og kurser, der afholdes årligt.




Vi er et mindre team, og det betyder, at du får mulighed for at følge løsninger hele vejen fra den første idé og dialog med forretningen til udvikling, implementering og efterfølgende optimering.

Du kommer både til at arbejde med data engineering, data science og analyse, og vi leder derfor ikke efter en profil, der nødvendigvis ønsker at bruge hele dagen på udvikling af ML-modeller.




Det afgørende er, at du har en god dataforståelse, kan arbejde hands-on med teknologien og samtidig er nysgerrig på, hvordan data kan anvendes til at løse konkrete behov og skabe værdi.




Vær med til at bygge vores nye dataplatform

Vi er i gang med en vigtig udvikling af vores dataområde, hvor vi bevæger os fra en traditionel data- og rapporteringsplatform mod en moderne og mere sammenhængende dataplatform.

Databricks bliver fremadrettet vores samlede platform for BI og Data Science, og en central del af jobbet bliver at være med til at udvikle denne platform.




Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

migrering af eksisterende data, modeller og løsninger
udvikling og vedligeholdelse af ETL-flows og data pipelines
datamodellering og strukturering af data
optimering og videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger
udvikling af nye dataløsninger og use cases
data science, analyser og prædiktive modeller
videreudvikling af blandt andet churn-modeller, anbefalingssystemer og andre løsninger, der kan forbedre medlemsoplevelsen.




Vores tech stack omfatter blandt andet Python, SQL, Azure og Databricks samt AI-understøttede coding tools som Codex.




Python bliver et af dine primære arbejdsredskaber, og erfaring med Databricks vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er dog din grundlæggende forståelse for data, dataflows og moderne dataplatforme.




Teknologi skal skabe værdi

For os er teknologien ikke et mål i sig selv.

Udviklingen af vores dataplatform og løsninger er use case-drevet, og vi er optagede af, hvordan data konkret kan gøre IDA bedre til at forstå vores medlemmer, forudse deres behov og skabe bedre medlemsoplevelser.




Derfor skal du også have lyst til at komme ud af det tekniske maskinrum. Du skal kunne gå i dialog med kolleger og forretningsbrugere, forstå deres behov og udfordringer og være med til at omsætte dem til dataløsninger, der giver mening. Det kræver både teknisk forståelse, analytisk nysgerrighed og evnen til at se muligheder sammen med andre.




Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du minimum har nogle års praktisk erfaring inden for data science, data engineering eller en kombination af de to.




Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

har gode kompetencer i Python og SQL
har erfaring med eller interesse for data science, analyse og machine learning
har praktisk erfaring med data pipelines og datamodellering.
har arbejdet med Databricks eller tilsvarende moderne dataplatforme moderne dataplatforme
har en god grundlæggende dataforståelse og kan arbejde på tværs af forskellige dele af datakæden
kan arbejde både med eksisterende løsninger og udviklingen af nye
er struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs
har lyst til løbende at udvikle både dig selv, teamet og vores løsninger
trives med dialog med forretningen om behov, muligheder og anvendelse af data.




Det er ikke afgørende, om din nuværende titel er Data Scientist, Data Engineer eller noget tredje. Det vigtigste er, at du har den faglige bredde og nysgerrighed, der gør dig i stand til at bevæge dig mellem data, teknologi og forretning.




Et team, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen

Du bliver en del af et velfungerende team, hvor høj faglighed kombineres med et godt socialt fællesskab og ikke mindst stor fleksibilitet.




Vi arbejder tæt sammen, deler viden og bruger hinanden aktivt i hverdagen. Vi værdsætter derfor også den fysiske tilstedeværelse og søger en kollega, der har lyst til at være en aktiv del af både det faglige og sociale fællesskab.




Til gengæld får du en rolle med stor faglig bredde og mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af IDAs fremtidige dataplatform, og med tiden også mulighed for at bevæge dig yderligere i retning af eksempelvis AI og nye anvendelser af data.




Ansøgning

Hvis du kan se dig selv i jobbet og som vores nye kollega, ser vi frem til at læse din ansøgning!

I denne ansættelsesproces bliver vi assisteret af European Search Company. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Brian Ranvits på; +45 2048 0548 eller Christoffer Bjørk Petersen på; +45 2080 1638




Ansøgning og CV fremsendes elektronisk via nedenstående ansøgningsknap.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtale. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!




IDA opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Title: Quantitative Researcher - Power Markets
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Quantitative Researcher – Time Series & Signal Processing




Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Onsite)




Experience Level: Mid-Senior (2+ Years Professional or Applied PhD Research Experience)




Company: PowerXecution




About PowerXecution

PowerXecution is an algorithmic trading firm based in Copenhagen, backed by long-term institutional capital. We specialize in automated, data-driven trading strategies across European power markets. Operating with a flat organizational structure, our quants, developers, and experienced power traders work collaboratively to engineer scalable execution systems and low-latency quantitative models designed to operate at high capacity across continuous intraday and auction markets.




The Role

Title: AI-specialist inden for sprogmodeller og generativ AI
Place: Taastrup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at forme næste generation af AI-løsninger i dansk erhvervsliv og opbygge skalerbare systemer baseret på LLM, RAG og agentisk AI?

Teknologisk Institut søger en stærk og nysgerrig AI-specialist til sektionen Dataanvendelse i Taastrup. Vi oplever en stigende efterspørgsel på værdiskabende AI-applikationer og ønsker at udvide vores kapacitet inden for sprogmodeller, RAG, fine-tuning og agentiske AI-systemer. Du får en nøglerolle i at rådgive virksomheder, afdække nye teknologiske muligheder og omsætte avanceret AI til driftssikre løsninger med reel forretningsværdi.

Praktisk AI-udvikling med direkte forretningsværdi

I denne rolle bliver du en drivkraft i at bygge bro mellem den nyeste AI-forskning og kommerciel anvendelse. Din primære opgave bliver at designe, implementere og optimere sprogmodelbaserede arkitekturer. Det daglige arbejde spænder bredt - fra datapræparering, retrieval og modeltilpasning til evaluering, API-integration og deployment i lokale eller cloudbaserede miljøer.

Selvom sprogmodeller udgør dit kernefokus, vil du også indgå i sektionens øvrige AI- og data science-projekter, som blandt andet omfatter billed- og videoanalyse.

Dine Primære Opgaver Bliver At


Udvikle løsninger baseret på sprogmodeller, RAG-arkitekturer, fine-tuning og agentiske systemer
Afvikle og teste modeller på vores lokale GPU-infrastruktur (SLURM) samt i skyen og hybride opsætninger
Rådgive kunder og drive tekniske forløb fra indledende behovsafklaring og arkitekturdesign til endelig aflevering
Identificere nye anvendelsesmuligheder, opbygge projektidéer samt bidrage til fondsansøgninger og kommercielle tilbud
Sparre på tværs af sektionen om projekter inden for computer vision, billedanalyse og procesoptimering


Du træder ind i en stilling med betydeligt fagligt råderum og kort vej fra idé til handling. Vi råder over en moderne digital infrastruktur med lokal GPU-hardware, hvilket giver dig ideelle betingelser for at eksperimentere, bygge og teste komplekse modeller. Du bliver en del af et specialiseret team i Taastrup, hvor vi lægger vægt på høj faglig kvalitet, videndeling og løsninger, der gør en målbar forskel for vores kunder.

Stærk teknisk AI-profil med blik for praktisk anvendelse

Du har en kandidatgrad eller ph.d. inden for et relevant teknisk område (f.eks. datalogi, AI, softwareudvikling, data science eller ingeniørvidenskab) samt dokumenteret erfaring med at nå helt i mål med sprogmodelbaserede applikationer.

Vi forventer, at du har stærke kompetencer inden for flere af følgende områder:


Sprogmodeller, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering og systematisk modelevaluering
Python og moderne softwareudvikling (Git, CI/CD, test og kodestruktur)
Linux-miljøer, Docker-containerisering samt MLOps / ML-DevOps
Modeldeployment på tværs af on-premise, cloud- og hybridinfrastruktur
Håndtering af GPU-ressourcer og modeloptimering


Erfaring med kundevendte tekniske forløb eller fondsansøgninger er en klar fordel. Som person arbejder du struktureret og selvstændigt med en naturlig lyst til at sætte dig ind i nye teknologier. Du er god til at forklare komplekse tekniske valg på en letforståelig måde over for kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Du bliver en del af Teknologisk Institut

Hos Teknologisk Institut bliver du en del af en stærk tværfaglig organisation, hvor vi arbejder med at bringe ny teknologi i anvendelse i virksomheder og samfund.

Du bliver en del af centeret Bæredygtighed og Digitalisering og tilknyttes sektionen Dataanvendelse i Taastrup. Her arbejder vi i feltet mellem avanceret sensorteknologi, data science, anvendt AI og digitale løsninger på tværs af brancher. Centerets ambition er at være den førende innovationspartner for digitale og teknologiske løsninger, hvor vi blandt andet udnytter komplekse data og fysiske målesystemer til at optimere alt fra industrielle processer til kvalitet og bæredygtighed i fødevaresektoren.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Kristian Gregersen på tlf. 7220 1282.

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via vores rekrutteringssystem senest den 15. september 2026.

Forventet Proces For Samtaler

Sæt gerne allerede nu kryds i kalenderen. Vi forventer at afholde samtaler på følgende datoer:


1. samtaler: 16. september
2. samtaler: 21. september

Title: Commercial AI & Data Lead - Aurocon
Description:
Kan du omsætte data fra Aurocons intelligente IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder til konkrete produkter, bedre beslutningsgrundlag og nye kommercielle muligheder?




Fra IoT-data til produktudvikling og forretningsmuligheder




Aurocons voksende base af IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder genererer store mængder data om blandt andet hændelser, sensoraktivitet, connectivity, batteri, drift og installationer. Som ansvarlig for AI & Data bringer du disse data i spil.




Stillingen kombinerer strategi med hands-on udvikling, og særligt i starten er du selv den tekniske drivkraft. Du analyserer data, skriver kode, bygger prototyper og dokumenterer, hvor AI og machine learning kan skabe reel kunde- og forretningsværdi.




Dit ansvar omfatter blandt andet at:

kombinere IoT- og tidsseriedata med produktdata, historiske hændelser, supportviden og teknisk dokumentation
skabe struktur, kvalitet og en skalerbar arkitektur omkring virksomhedens datagrundlag
udvikle machine-learning-løsninger til analyse, anomalidetektion, klassifikation og prædiktion
definere og implementere Aurocons AI- og datastrategi
udvikle fundamentet for en modeluafhængig Aurocon AI Engine baseret på egne data og domæneviden
identificere nye AI- og dataprodukter, der øger værdien af Aurotrap-platformen og kan skabe recurring revenue
arbejde hands-on med LLM'er, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, function calling og AI-agenter
udvikle proof-of-concepts og bringe de rigtige løsninger fra prototype til produktion sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet




Du refererer direkte til CEO, arbejder tæt sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet og kommunikerer med både kunder og kommercielle samarbejdspartnere. CTO har ansvaret for hardware, embedded software, firmware og den tekniske produktplatform, mens du får ejerskab for data, analytics, machine learning og AI.




Teknisk builder med blik for produkt og forretning




Du er enten Head of AI i dag eller er klar til dit næste karriereskridt fra din nuværende position som AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Lead eller tilsvarende. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, evne til selv at bygge løsninger og din ambition om med tiden at tage et strategisk og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar.




Du har solid erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Data Science, Machine Learning og generativ AI
Python, SQL, data engineering og større datamængder
LLM-arkitektur, RAG, embeddings og vector databases
function calling og AI-agenter
API-integrationer, model deployment og MLOps/LLMOps
cloud-, data- og analyticsarkitektur.




Kendskab til f.eks. Qwen, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face eller vLLM er relevant. Du er ikke bundet til én teknologistak, men har en pragmatisk tilgang til teknologi og vurderer modeller og løsninger ud fra kvalitet, økonomi, latency, sikkerhed, GDPR, skalerbarhed og den konkrete forretningsværdi.




Derudover har du erfaring med IoT, tidsseriedata, hardware-enabled software og operationelle eventdata.




Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og selvkørende og trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd.




Din tekniske faglighed kombinerer du med et produkt- og forretningsorienteret mindset, der gør dig i stand til at prioritere muligheder ud fra kundeværdi, betalingsvillighed, differentiering, udviklingsomkostninger og skalerbarhed.




En spændende karrieremulighed




Du får en sjælden mulighed for at bygge et strategisk vigtigt område fra bunden. Aurocon har allerede de fysiske produkter, en international installeret base og et voksende datasæt fra enheder i virkelige miljøer. Ambitionen er, at data og AI bliver en central del af virksomhedens næste produktgeneration og langsigtede konkurrenceevne.




I takt med at området vokser, får du mulighed for at opbygge og lede et AI- og datateam. For den rette profil kan stillingen derfor blive et markant karriereskridt fra teknisk specialist til leder med et bredere strategisk teknologiansvar.




Om Aurocon




Auroconudvikler og producerer avancerede løsninger til skadedyrsbekæmpelse baseret på banebrydende teknologi.




Flagskibsproduktet The Aurotrap med tilhørende IT platform og mobil app, er en IoT baseret intelligent, giftfri multi-kill rottefælde, som gør det muligt at overvåge og håndtere rotteaktivitet i realtid.




Fra hovedsædet i Aalborg opererer Aurocon.io på internationale markeder og leverer løsninger, der forbedrer både operationel effektivitet og miljømæssig bæredygtighed.

Title: Trading Quant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 5317

Are you ready to be part of a team that drives transformation of the trading process - from client inflow to post-trade analysis? We are now looking for a curious Trading Quant that strives for data-driven decision-making, to enhance the measurability of the actions taken by traders and portfolio managers, and to enable our traders to better source liquidity and manage execution risk.

The role is a full time position based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Our Team

Meet the Trading Quants team. We add value by being change enablers that drive transformation of the investment process as part of an agile value stream where we identify business problems, define and implement solutions, to generate tangible value for our clients.

Our team is part of Nordea Asset Management, Global Trading. Within the investment management area, Global Trading, is responsible for order generation and trade execution on behalf of portfolio managers across asset classes. As a team, we homogenize data across asset classes, add structure and measurability to our investment processes, to unlock scale and quality throughout the organization.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Main responsibilities in this role:


Engage with traders to solve their execution challenges by providing them with data, frameworks, and tools that improve the search for liquidity and highlights execution risks.
Implement AI use cases leveraging our data models.
Drive projects within a value stream, binding together business and technology, to ensure we deliver tangible outcomes for our clients.
Ensure data-driven decision-making by expanding our Trading Data Model and its applications.
Interact with internal and external stakeholders, and our technology providers.
Extract data insights for client services and senior management on an ad-hoc basis.


You’ll join a motivated and experienced quant team that values a cooperative environment where you can draw on your teammates' expertise and commitment to excellence.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are someone who takes ownership of your work and is driven to make a meaningful impact, while being comfortable sharing your opinions and challenging established ways of thinking. You excel at both analytical and technical problem-solving skills, and have the ability to drive projects forward effectively within virtual team environments. You thrive on learning quickly, are interested in exploring alternative ways of working, and possess strong stakeholder management skills that enable you to build relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.
